local function notify(text)
	local oldPopup = mainGui:FindFirstChild("KMPopup")
	if oldPopup then oldPopup:Destroy() end

	local popup = Instance.new("Frame")
	popup.Name = "KMPopup"
	popup.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 30)
	popup.Position = UDim2.new(1, -190, 1, -40)
	popup.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
	popup.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
	popup.BorderSizePixel = 1
	popup.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 80)
	popup.ZIndex = 20
	popup.Parent = mainGui

	local pText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	pText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	pText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	pText.Text = text
	pText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
	pText.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	pText.TextSize = 12
	pText.ZIndex = 21
	pText.Parent = popup

	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(3)
		if popup and popup.Parent then
			TweenService:Create(popup, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(pText, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
			task.wait(0.4)
			popup:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

	local hue = 0
	while true do
		hue = (hue + 0.01) % 1
		cStroke.Color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
		task.wait(0.03)
	end
end)

local cDragging, cDragStart, cMoved, cStartPos = false, nil, false, nil
circleBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		cDragging = true
		cMoved = false
		cDragStart = input.Position
		cStartPos = circleBtn.Position
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and cDragging then
		local delta = input.Position - cDragStart
		if delta.Magnitude > 3 then cMoved = true end
		circleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(cStartPos.X.Scale, cStartPos.X.Offset + delta.X, cStartPos.Y.Scale, cStartPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		cDragging = false
	end
end)

topBarDrag.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		winDragging = true
		winDragStart = input.Position
		winStartPos = mainFrame.Position
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and winDragging then
		local delta = input.Position - winDragStart
		mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(winStartPos.X.Scale, winStartPos.X.Offset + delta.X, winStartPos.Y.Scale, winStartPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
		local targetRotation = math.clamp(delta.X * 0.12, -8, 8)
		mainFrame.Rotation = mainFrame.Rotation + (targetRotation - mainFrame.Rotation) * 0.2
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		winDragging = false
	end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if mainFrame.Visible and not winDragging then
		mainFrame.Rotation = mainFrame.Rotation + (0 - mainFrame.Rotation) * 0.15
	end
end)

local killAllActive = false
killAllBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	killAllActive = not killAllActive
	if killAllActive then
		TweenService:Create(killAllBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 80)}):Play()
		killAllBtn.Text = translations[currentLang].killAllOn
		notify(translations[currentLang].enabled)
		
		task.spawn(function()
			local char = player.Character
			local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not root then return end
			local originalCFrame = root.CFrame

			while killAllActive do
				for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
					if not killAllActive then break end
					if p ~= player and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
						local targetRoot = p.Character.HumanoidRootPart
						local isTargetIt = false
						pcall(function()
							if p.Character:FindFirstChild("Knife") or (p.Team and p.Team.Name == "It") then
								isTargetIt = true
							end
						end)

						if not isTargetIt then
							root.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1.5)
							task.wait(0.2)
						end
					end
				end
				task.wait(0.5)
			end

			if root and root.Parent then
				root.CFrame = originalCFrame
			end
		end)
	else
		TweenService:Create(killAllBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 220)}):Play()
		killAllBtn.Text = translations[currentLang].killAllOff
		notify(translations[currentLang].disabled)
	end
end)

scripts.author: turkishpainter25

scripts.code:
local genv = getgenv()

if genv.VLHitbox then
	local old = genv.VLHitbox

	if old.render then
		old.render:Disconnect()
	end

	if old.added then
		old.added:Disconnect()
	end

	if old.removed then
		old.removed:Disconnect()
	end

	for _, v in pairs(old.balls or {}) do
		pcall(function()
			if v.box then
				v.box:Destroy()
			end

			if v.ring then
				v.ring:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end
end

if genv.VolleyballLegendsHitboxExpander then
	pcall(function()
		genv.VolleyballLegendsHitboxExpander.cleanup()
	end)

	genv.VolleyballLegendsHitboxExpander = nil
end

local CS = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local RS = game:GetService("RunService")
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
local vec2 = Vector2.new

local rad = 12
local col = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)
local trans = 0.25
local thick = 2.5

local balls = {}

local function addBall(ball)
	if not ball:IsA("Model") or not ball:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		return
	end

	local root = ball.PrimaryPart or ball:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)

	if not root or balls[ball] then
		return
	end

	local box = Instance.new("Part")
	box.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	box.Size = Vector3.new(rad * 2, rad * 2, rad * 2)
	box.CFrame = root.CFrame
	box.Transparency = 1
	box.CanCollide = false
	box.CanTouch = false
	box.CanQuery = true
	box.Anchored = true
	box.CastShadow = false
	box.Massless = true
	box.Parent = ball

	local ring = Drawing.new("Circle")
	ring.Color = col
	ring.Filled = false
	ring.NumSides = 128
	ring.Thickness = thick
	ring.Transparency = trans
	ring.Visible = false

	balls[ball] = {
		box = box,
		ring = ring
	}
end

local function killBall(ball)
	local d = balls[ball]

	if not d then
		return
	end

	pcall(function()
		d.box:Destroy()
		d.ring:Destroy()
	end)

	balls[ball] = nil
end

local added = CS:GetInstanceAddedSignal("Ball"):Connect(addBall)
local removed = CS:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("Ball"):Connect(killBall)

local render = RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

	for ball, d in pairs(balls) do
		local root = ball.PrimaryPart or ball:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)

		if not root or not ball.Parent then
			killBall(ball)
		else
			d.box.CFrame = root.CFrame

			local pos, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)

			if on and pos.Z > 0 then
				local edge = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position + cam.CFrame.RightVector * rad)
				local r = math.abs(edge.X - pos.X)

				if r ~= r or r <= 0 then
					d.ring.Visible = false
				else
					d.ring.Position = vec2(pos.X, pos.Y)
					d.ring.Radius = r
					d.ring.Visible = true
				end
			else
				d.ring.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end
end)

for _, ball in ipairs(CS:GetTagged("Ball")) do
	addBall(ball)
end

genv.VLHitbox = {
	render = render,
	added = added,
	removed = removed,
	balls = balls
}

scripts.title: Vehicle Fly | Open Source
scripts.author: turkishpainter25
scripts.summary: Simple Vehicle Fly Keybind: V
scripts.code:
local players = game:GetService("Players")
local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
local inputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = players.LocalPlayer
local vehicles = workspace:WaitForChild("Vehicles")
local atvs = workspace:WaitForChild("ATVs")

local enabled = false
local activeVehicle
local cameraTarget
local cameraOffset
local cameraTargetRotation
local cameraDistance
local savedCameraSubject

local function getVehicle()
    local character = player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local seat = humanoid and humanoid.SeatPart

    if not seat or not seat:IsA("VehicleSeat") or seat.Name ~= "DriverSeat" then
        return
    end

    local vehicle = seat.Parent
    if vehicle and (vehicle.Parent == vehicles or vehicle.Parent == atvs) then
        return vehicle, seat
    end
end

local function getDirection(camera)
    local direction = Vector3.zero

    if inputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
        direction += camera.CFrame.LookVector
    end

    if inputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
        direction -= camera.CFrame.LookVector
    end

    if inputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
        direction += camera.CFrame.RightVector
    end

    if inputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
        direction -= camera.CFrame.RightVector
    end

    return direction.Magnitude > 1 and direction.Unit or direction
end

local function resetCamera()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local character = player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local subject = savedCameraSubject

    if humanoid and not humanoid.SeatPart then
        subject = humanoid
    end

    if subject and subject.Parent then
        camera.CameraSubject = subject
    elseif humanoid then
        camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
    end

    if cameraTarget then
        cameraTarget:Destroy()
    end

    activeVehicle = nil
    cameraTarget = nil
    cameraOffset = nil
    cameraTargetRotation = nil
    cameraDistance = nil
    savedCameraSubject = nil
end

local function attachCamera(vehicle, seat)
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local subject = camera.CameraSubject
    local source = typeof(subject) == "Instance" and subject:IsA("BasePart") and subject or seat
    local target = Instance.new(source:IsA("VehicleSeat") and "VehicleSeat" or "Part")

    target.Name = "VehicleFlyCamera"
    target.Size = source.Size
    target.Transparency = 1
    target.Anchored = true
    target.CanCollide = false
    target.CanQuery = false
    target.CanTouch = false
    target.CFrame = source.CFrame
    target.Parent = workspace

    savedCameraSubject = subject
    cameraTarget = target
    cameraOffset = vehicle:GetPivot():PointToObjectSpace(source.Position)
    cameraTargetRotation = source.CFrame.Rotation
    cameraDistance = (camera.CFrame.Position - camera.Focus.Position).Magnitude
    camera.CameraSubject = target
end

inputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, typing)
    if not typing and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.V then
        enabled = not enabled

        if not enabled then
            resetCamera()
        end
    end
end)

inputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if enabled and cameraDistance and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
        local zoomStep = math.max(1, cameraDistance * 0.15)
        cameraDistance = math.clamp(
            cameraDistance - input.Position.Z * zoomStep,
            player.CameraMinZoomDistance,
            player.CameraMaxZoomDistance
        )
    end
end)

runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
    if not enabled then
        return
    end

    local vehicle, seat = getVehicle()
    if not vehicle then
        if activeVehicle then
            resetCamera()
        end

        return
    end

    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local pivot = vehicle:GetPivot()

    if vehicle ~= activeVehicle then
        resetCamera()
        activeVehicle = vehicle
        attachCamera(vehicle, seat)
    end

    local focusPosition = camera.Focus.Position
    local cameraOffsetFromFocus = camera.CFrame.Position - focusPosition

    if cameraOffsetFromFocus.Magnitude > 0 then
        local cameraPosition = focusPosition + cameraOffsetFromFocus.Unit * cameraDistance
        camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(cameraPosition) * camera.CFrame.Rotation
    end

    local direction = getDirection(camera)
    local speed = inputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) and 240 or 120
    local position = pivot.Position + direction * speed * deltaTime

    local targetPivot = CFrame.new(position) * camera.CFrame.Rotation
    local targetPosition = targetPivot:PointToWorldSpace(cameraOffset)

    vehicle:PivotTo(targetPivot)
    cameraTarget.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPosition) * cameraTargetRotation

    local body = vehicle:FindFirstChild("Body")
    local base = body and body:FindFirstChild("Base") or seat
    base.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    base.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end)

scripts.author: turkishpainter25
scripts.summary: - Auto Delivery Job [10M+ per hour] - Anti-AFK
scripts.code:
if getgenv().DEAutoDelivery then return end

local Plrs = game:GetService('Players')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local CS = game:GetService('CollectionService')
local RS = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local VU = game:GetService('VirtualUser')

local plr = Plrs.LocalPlayer
local delivery = require(RS.Modules.Client.Jobs.Tasks.DeliveryJobTask)
local deliveryUtil = require(RS.Modules.Shared.Jobs.Delivery.DeliveryUtil)
local vehicles = require(RS.Modules.Client.Vehicles.VehicleController)
local vehicleUtil = require(RS.Modules.Shared.Vehicles.VehicleUtil)
local towablesUtil = require(RS.Modules.Shared.Towables.TowablesUtil)
local towables = require(RS.Modules.Client.Towables.TowablesController)
local towablesData = require(RS.Modules.Shared.DataManager.Data.TowablesData)
local vehicleData = require(RS.Modules.Shared.DataManager.Data.VehicleData)
local tpGuard = require(RS.Modules.Client.Exploit.VehicleTeleportDetectionController)

getgenv().DEAutoDelivery = true

if getconnections then
    pcall(function()
        for _, v in ipairs(getconnections(plr.Idled)) do
            v:Disable()
        end
    end)
end

plr.Idled:Connect(function()
    pcall(function()
        VU:CaptureController()
        VU:ClickButton2(Vector2.zero)
    end)
end)

local function getLoc(pos, skipLast, towing)
    local loc, dist

    for _, v in ipairs(CS:GetTagged('DeliveryLocation')) do
        if v:IsA('BasePart') and v.Parent
            and (towing == nil or deliveryUtil.IsLocationAllowedForTrailer(v, towing)) then
            if not skipLast or not deliveryUtil.IsLastDeliveryLocation(plr, v) then
                local d = (v.Position - pos).Magnitude
                if not dist or d < dist then loc, dist = v, d end
            end
        end
    end

    return loc
end

local hover, hoverPart

local function clearHover()
    if hover then hover:Destroy() end
    hover, hoverPart = nil, nil
end

local carId, trailerId, checked, spawnAt, trailerAt

local function setupVehicle(hum, state)
    if not checked then
        local owned = vehicleData.GetOwnedVehicleIds(plr, true)
        local capacity = 0

        for id, v in pairs(towablesUtil.GetEnabledTowables()) do
            if v.ChassisType == 'Generic' and (v.CargoCapacity or 0) > capacity
                and towablesData.IsTowableUnlocked(plr, id) then
                for _, vehicleId in ipairs(owned) do
                    if towablesUtil.CanVehicleTowTowable(vehicleId, id, plr) then
                        carId, trailerId, capacity = vehicleId, id, v.CargoCapacity
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        checked = true
    end

    if not carId then
        if hum.SeatPart then
            clearHover()
            hum.Sit = false
            hum.Jump = true
            return false
        end

        return true
    end

    local model = vehicleUtil.GetPlayerSpawnedVehicle(plr)
    local carType = model and model:FindFirstChild('CarType')

    if not carType or carType.Value ~= carId then
        if state and ((state.ItemsCarried or 0) > 0 or state.IsDropping) then return false end
        if not spawnAt or tick() - spawnAt > 10 then
            clearHover()
            spawnAt, trailerAt = tick(), nil
            RS.Remotes.VehicleEvent:FireServer('Spawn', carId)
        end

        return false
    end

    local car = vehicleUtil.getPlayerData(plr)
    if not car or car.Model ~= model then
        clearHover()
        local seat = model:FindFirstChild('VehicleSeat')
        if seat and not seat.Occupant then seat:Sit(hum) end
        return false
    end

    local trailer = towablesUtil.GetAttachedTrailerFromVehicle(model)
    if not trailer or trailer:GetAttribute('TowableId') ~= trailerId then
        if state and ((state.ItemsCarried or 0) > 0 or state.IsDropping) then return false end
        if not trailerAt or tick() - trailerAt > 10 then
            clearHover()
            trailerAt = tick()
            local ok, err = towables.AttemptToSpawnTowable(trailerId)
            if not ok then warn('[DE] ' .. tostring(err)) end
        end

        return false
    end

    return true
end

local function tp(cf)
    local char = plr.Character
    if not char then return false end

    local car = vehicleUtil.getPlayerData(plr)
    local chassis = vehicles.getActiveChassisController()

    if car and car.Model and car.WeightPart then
        if not car.Model.Parent or not car.WeightPart.Parent then return false end
        local trailer = towablesUtil.GetAttachedTrailerFromVehicle(car.Model)
        local offset = trailer and car.WeightPart.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(trailer:GetPivot())
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if hum and hum.SeatPart then cf = cf * hum.SeatPart.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(car.WeightPart.CFrame) end
        if chassis then chassis.Teleporting = true end

        task.defer(function()
            if chassis then chassis.Teleporting = false end
        end)

        tpGuard.AuthorizeNextTeleport()
        car.Model.PrimaryPart = car.WeightPart
        car.Model:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(cf)
        if trailer and trailer.Parent then trailer:PivotTo(cf * offset) end
        car.WeightPart.Anchored = false
        clearHover()

        hover = Instance.new('BodyVelocity')
        hover.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
        hover.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        hover.Parent = car.WeightPart
        hoverPart = car.WeightPart

        for _, model in ipairs({car.Model, trailer}) do
            for _, v in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                if v:IsA('BasePart') then
                    v.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    v.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end
            end
        end
    else
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if hum and hum.SeatPart then return false end
        char:PivotTo(cf)

        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if hrp then
            clearHover()

            hover = Instance.new('BodyVelocity')
            hover.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
            hover.Velocity = Vector3.zero
            hover.Parent = hrp
            hoverPart = hrp

            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
    end

    return true
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local char = plr.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')

    if hoverPart and (not hoverPart.Parent or not hrp or plr:GetAttribute('JobId') ~= 'Delivery'
        or (hoverPart ~= hrp and (not hum or not hum.SeatPart))) then
        clearHover()
    end

    if hrp then hrp.Anchored = false end
    if hum and hover and hover.Parent == hrp then
        hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
    end
end)

local curTarget, curLoc, curPhase, lastTick, lastFire, progressAt, lastTp, lastChar, lastState, retryAt

RS.Remotes.DeliveryCompleted.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(result)
    if result and result.FailureReason then
        warn('[DE] delivery failed: ' .. tostring(result.FailureReason) .. ', phase=' .. tostring(curPhase)
            .. ', packages=' .. tostring(lastState and lastState.ItemsCarried)
            .. ', collecting=' .. tostring(lastState and lastState.IsCollecting)
            .. ', dropping=' .. tostring(lastState and lastState.IsDropping))
    end
end)

local function step()
    local char = plr.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')

    if char ~= lastChar then
        clearHover()
        curTarget, curLoc, curPhase, lastTick, lastFire, progressAt, lastTp, lastState = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
        lastChar = char
        spawnAt, trailerAt, retryAt = nil, nil, nil
    end

    if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
        if retryAt and tick() < retryAt then return end
        retryAt = nil

        local state = delivery.GetCurrentDeliveryState()
        if not setupVehicle(hum, state) then return end

        if plr:GetAttribute('JobId') ~= 'Delivery' then
            RS.Remotes.RequestStartJobSession:FireServer('Delivery', 'deliveryHub', 'HighRisk')
            clearHover()
            curTarget, curLoc, curPhase, lastTick, lastFire, progressAt, lastTp, lastState = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
            task.wait(0.5)
        else
            local target, phase
            local remaining = state and state.ExpirationTime and state.ExpirationTime - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

            local newRoute = state and (not lastState or state.PickupPosition ~= lastState.PickupPosition
                or state.DestinationPosition ~= lastState.DestinationPosition
                or state.DeliveryStartTime ~= lastState.DeliveryStartTime)

            if newRoute then
                curTarget, curLoc, curPhase, lastFire = nil, nil, nil, nil
            end

            if not progressAt or newRoute or (state == nil) ~= (lastState == nil)
                or (state and lastState and (state.ItemsCarried ~= lastState.ItemsCarried
                    or state.PackagesRemainingAtPickup ~= lastState.PackagesRemainingAtPickup
                    or state.IsPlanned ~= lastState.IsPlanned)) then
                progressAt = tick()
            end

            lastState = state

            if state then
                lastTick = nil

                local carried = state.ItemsCarried or 0
                local cap = state.MaxCapacity or carried
                local full = carried >= cap
                local noMore = state.PackagesRemainingAtPickup == 0

                if state.IsDropping or curPhase == 'drop'
                    or carried > 0 and (full or noMore or remaining and remaining <= 5) then
                    phase = 'drop'
                    target = state.DestinationPosition
                else
                    phase = 'pickup'
                    target = state.PickupPosition
                end
            else
                lastTick = lastTick or tick()

                if tick() - lastTick > 0.25 then
                    local car = vehicleUtil.getPlayerData(plr)
                    local towing = car and towablesUtil.GetAttachedTrailerFromVehicle(car.Model) ~= nil or false
                    local loc = getLoc(hrp.Position, true, towing)
                    phase = 'new'
                    target = loc and loc.Position
                end
            end

            if target then
                local pos = target + Vector3.new(0, math.min(3.5, deliveryUtil.GetPickupRadius() / 2), 0)
                local part = hum.SeatPart or hrp
                if target ~= curTarget or phase ~= curPhase
                    or ((part.Position - pos).Magnitude > deliveryUtil.GetPickupRadius() / 2 and tick() - (lastTp or 0) > 2) then
                    if curLoc then RS.Remotes.DeliveryLocationLeft:FireServer(curLoc) end
                    if not tp(CFrame.new(pos)) then return end
                    curTarget, curPhase, lastTp = target, phase, tick()
                    curLoc, lastFire = nil, nil
                end

                if tick() - (lastTp or 0) < 0.5 then return end

                local loc = getLoc(target)

                if loc and (loc.Position - target).Magnitude < 1
                    and (part.Position - loc.Position).Magnitude <= deliveryUtil.GetPickupRadius() then
                    if loc ~= curLoc then progressAt = tick() end

                    local timeout = math.max(10, deliveryUtil.GetItemCollectTime(plr) * 3)
                    if phase == 'drop' and remaining then timeout = math.min(timeout, math.max(2, remaining / 2)) end

                    if loc == curLoc and tick() - progressAt > timeout then
                        RS.Remotes.DeliveryLocationLeft:FireServer(loc)
                        if not tp(CFrame.new(target + Vector3.new(deliveryUtil.GetPickupRadius() + 8, 3.5, 0))) then return end
                        curTarget, curLoc, lastFire = nil, nil, nil
                        progressAt, retryAt = tick(), tick() + 0.5
                        return
                    end

                    local busy = state and (phase == 'drop' and state.IsDropping
                        or phase ~= 'drop' and state.IsCollecting)
                    if loc ~= curLoc or not busy and tick() - (lastFire or 0) > 2 then
                        RS.Remotes.DeliveryLocationInteracted:FireServer(loc)
                        curLoc, lastFire = loc, tick()
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

while task.wait(0.1) do
    local ok, err = pcall(step)
    if not ok then
        curTarget, curLoc, curPhase, lastTick, lastFire, progressAt, lastTp, lastState = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
        clearHover()
        warn('[DE] ' .. tostring(err))
        task.wait(1)
    end
end

scripts.summary: this script only focus on guns in Shinjuku 1988 it draws what gun is in other players inventory simple script open source.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

getgenv().InvESP = {
    Enabled = true,
    TextSize = 13,
    Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)  
}

local ESP_Drawings = {}
local importantWeapons = {"nambu", "howa", "p9", "mp5", "mossberg", "fishing rod"}  

local function GetPlayerInventory(player)
    local items = {}
    if not player.Character then return items end

    
    for _, tool in ipairs(player.Character:GetChildren()) do
        if tool:IsA("Tool") then
            local nameLower = tool.Name:lower()
            for _, w in ipairs(importantWeapons) do
                if nameLower:find(w) then
                    table.insert(items, tool.Name)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end

        local inventory = player:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
    if inventory then
        for _, slot in ipairs(inventory:GetChildren()) do
            if slot.Name:find("Slot") then
                for _, tool in ipairs(slot:GetChildren()) do
                    if tool:IsA("Tool") then
                        local nameLower = tool.Name:lower()
                        for _, w in ipairs(importantWeapons) do
                            if nameLower:find(w) then
                                table.insert(items, tool.Name)
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    
    local unique = {}
    for _, v in ipairs(items) do
        unique[v] = true
    end
    local final = {}
    for k in pairs(unique) do
        table.insert(final, k)
    end

    return final
end

local function RemoveESP(playerName)
    if ESP_Drawings[playerName] then
        ESP_Drawings[playerName]:Remove()
        ESP_Drawings[playerName] = nil
    end
end

local function UpdateInventoryESP()
    if not getgenv().InvESP.Enabled then
        for _, drawing in pairs(ESP_Drawings) do
            drawing.Visible = false
        end
        return
    end

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player == LocalPlayer then continue end

        local character = player.Character
        if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            RemoveESP(player.Name)
            continue
        end

        local items = GetPlayerInventory(player)
        if #items == 0 then
            RemoveESP(player.Name)
            continue
        end

        local root = character.HumanoidRootPart
        local screen, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0))

        if not onScreen then
            RemoveESP(player.Name)
            continue
        end

        if not ESP_Drawings[player.Name] then
            local esp = Drawing.new("Text")
            esp.Color = getgenv().InvESP.Color
            esp.Outline = true
            esp.Center = true
            esp.Size = getgenv().InvESP.TextSize
            ESP_Drawings[player.Name] = esp
        end

        local esp = ESP_Drawings[player.Name]
        esp.Text = table.concat(items, "\n")
        esp.Position = Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y)
        esp.Visible = true
    end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(RemoveESP)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    for playerName in pairs(ESP_Drawings) do
        local player = Players:FindFirstChild(playerName)
        if not player or not player.Character or not player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            RemoveESP(playerName)
        end
    end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(UpdateInventoryESP)

game:GetService("UserInputService").InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F4 then
        getgenv().InvESP.Enabled = not getgenv().InvESP.Enabled
        print("Inventory ESP:", getgenv().InvESP.Enabled and "ON" or "OFF")
    end
end)

print("Clean White Inventory ESP Loaded | Press F4 to toggle")

scripts.author: AxonicHub
scripts.summary: Rivals Gun Silent Aim & Esp Rivals rivals Rival rival
scripts.code:
-- Join Discord For More Open Sources, Coming Soon https://discord.gg/axonic

repeat task.wait() until game:IsLoaded()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer or Players.PlayerAdded:Wait()
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G

if type(env.AxonicRivalsCleanup) == "function" then
    pcall(env.AxonicRivalsCleanup)
end

local function safeRequire(instance)
    if not instance then return end
    local ok, result = pcall(require, instance)
    if ok then return result end
end

local scripts = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts")
local Gun = safeRequire(scripts:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("ItemTypes"):WaitForChild("Gun"))
local controllers = scripts:WaitForChild("Controllers")
local FighterController = safeRequire(controllers:WaitForChild("FighterController"))
local DuelController = safeRequire(controllers:FindFirstChild("DuelController"))
local Utility = safeRequire(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("Utility"))
if not (Gun and FighterController and Utility) then
    return
end

local State = {
    SilentAim = true,
    AimPart = "Smart",
    ShowFOV = true,
    FOV = 180,
    WallCheck = true,
    StickyTarget = true,
    HitChance = 100,
    MaxHitDistance = 350,
    ESP = true,
}
local lockGrace = 0.18

local Connections = {}
local function connect(signal, fn)
    local c = signal:Connect(fn)
    Connections[#Connections + 1] = c
    return c
end
local function getHumanoid(character)
    return character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
end
local function isAlive(player)
    local humanoid = getHumanoid(player and player.Character)
    return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end
local function getLocalDuel()
    if not DuelController or not DuelController.GetDuel then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, duel = pcall(DuelController.GetDuel, DuelController, LocalPlayer)
    return ok and duel or nil
end
local function isEnemy(player)
    if not player or player == LocalPlayer then
        return false
    end
    local duel = getLocalDuel()
    if not duel or not duel.GetDueler then
        return false
    end
    local okMine, myDueler = pcall(duel.GetDueler, duel, LocalPlayer)
    local okTheirs, theirDueler = pcall(duel.GetDueler, duel, player)
    if not okMine or not okTheirs or not myDueler or not theirDueler then
        return false
    end
    local myTeam
    local theirTeam
    if myDueler.Get then
        pcall(function()
            myTeam = myDueler:Get("TeamID")
        end)
    end
    if theirDueler.Get then
        pcall(function()
            theirTeam = theirDueler:Get("TeamID")
        end)
    end
    if myTeam ~= nil and theirTeam ~= nil then
        return myTeam ~= theirTeam
    end
    return true
end
local RayParams = RaycastParams.new()
RayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
RayParams.IgnoreWater = true
local function updateRayFilter()
    local list = {}
    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        table.insert(list, LocalPlayer.Character)
    end
    RayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = list
end
updateRayFilter()
connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded, function()
    task.defer(updateRayFilter)
end)
local function rawVisibleFrom(origin, character, part)
    if not (origin and character and part) then
        return false
    end
    local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, part.Position - origin, RayParams)
    return not result or result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character)
end
local function visibleFrom(origin, character, part)
    if not State.WallCheck then
        return true
    end
    return rawVisibleFrom(origin, character, part)
end
local SmartParts = {
    "Head",
    "UpperTorso",
    "LowerTorso",
    "HumanoidRootPart",
    "LeftUpperArm",
    "RightUpperArm",
    "LeftUpperLeg",
    "RightUpperLeg",
}
local CurrentTargetPlayer
local CurrentTargetPart
local CurrentTargetLostAt = 0
local function targetParts(character)
    if State.AimPart ~= "Smart" then
        local part = character and character:FindFirstChild(State.AimPart)
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
        print("Join Discord https://discord.gg/axonic")
            return {part}
        end
        return {}
    end
    local parts = {}
    for _, name in ipairs(SmartParts) do
        local part = character and character:FindFirstChild(name)
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            table.insert(parts, part)
        end
    end
    return parts
end
local function getPartMetrics(part)
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera or not part then
        return nil
    end
    local screen, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
    if not onScreen or screen.Z <= 0 then
        return nil
    end
    local viewport = Camera.ViewportSize
    local center = Vector2.new(viewport.X * 0.5, viewport.Y * 0.5)
    local screenDistance = (Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - center).Magnitude
    local worldDistance = (part.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
    return screenDistance, worldDistance
end
local function bestPartForPlayer(player)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then
        return nil
    end
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera then
        return nil
    end
    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local bestPart
    local bestPartScore = math.huge
    local bestScreenDistance
    local bestWorldDistance
    for _, part in ipairs(targetParts(character)) do
        local screenDistance, worldDistance = getPartMetrics(part)
        if screenDistance
            and worldDistance <= State.MaxHitDistance
            and screenDistance <= State.FOV
            and visibleFrom(origin, character, part) then
            local priorityPenalty = 0
            if State.AimPart == "Smart" then
                if part.Name == "Head" then
                    priorityPenalty = 0
                elseif part.Name == "UpperTorso" then
                    priorityPenalty = 1.5
                elseif part.Name == "LowerTorso" or part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
                    priorityPenalty = 3
                else
                    priorityPenalty = 6
                end
            end
            local partScore = screenDistance + priorityPenalty
            if partScore < bestPartScore then
                bestPartScore = partScore
                bestPart = part
                bestScreenDistance = screenDistance
                bestWorldDistance = worldDistance
            end
        end
    end
    return bestPart, bestScreenDistance, bestWorldDistance
end
local function findBestTarget()
    local bestPlayer
    local bestPart
    local bestScore = math.huge
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if isEnemy(player) and isAlive(player) then
            local part, screenDistance, worldDistance = bestPartForPlayer(player)
            if part then
                local score = screenDistance + worldDistance * 0.035
                if score < bestScore then
                    bestScore = score
                    bestPlayer = player
                    bestPart = part
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return bestPlayer, bestPart
end
local function lockedTargetStillValid()
    local player = CurrentTargetPlayer
    local part = CurrentTargetPart
    if not State.StickyTarget or not player or not part then
        return false
    end
    if not player.Parent or not part.Parent or not isEnemy(player) or not isAlive(player) then
        return false
    end
    local screenDistance, worldDistance = getPartMetrics(part)
    if not screenDistance then
        return false
    end
    if worldDistance > State.MaxHitDistance or screenDistance > State.FOV * 1.20 then
        return false
    end
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if State.WallCheck and (not Camera or not visibleFrom(Camera.CFrame.Position, player.Character, part)) then
        return false
    end
    return true
end
local function acquireTarget(forceFresh)
    local now = os.clock()
    if lockedTargetStillValid() then
        CurrentTargetLostAt = 0
        return CurrentTargetPlayer, CurrentTargetPart
    end
    if (not forceFresh) and CurrentTargetPlayer and State.StickyTarget and lockGrace > 0 then
        if CurrentTargetLostAt == 0 then
            CurrentTargetLostAt = now
            return nil, nil
        end
        if now - CurrentTargetLostAt < lockGrace then
            return nil, nil
        end
    end
    local player, part = findBestTarget()
    CurrentTargetPlayer = player
    CurrentTargetPart = part
    CurrentTargetLostAt = 0
    return player, part
end
local FOVCircle
pcall(function()
    if Drawing and Drawing.new then
        FOVCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
        FOVCircle.Filled = false
        FOVCircle.Thickness = 1
        FOVCircle.NumSides = 80
        FOVCircle.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        FOVCircle.Transparency = 0.85
    end
end)
local OriginalGunStartShooting = Gun.StartShooting
local ShotOffset = Utility:EncodeCFrame(CFrame.new(0.43, 0.25, 0.42))
local ShotKey0 = utf8.char(0)
local ShotKey1 = utf8.char(1)
local ShotKey2 = utf8.char(2)
local ShotKey3 = utf8.char(3)
local function buildShotPayload(origin, target, part)
    local aimCFrame = Utility:EncodeCFrame(CFrame.new(origin, target))
    return {
        [ShotKey0] = aimCFrame,
        [ShotKey1] = aimCFrame,
        [ShotKey2] = part,
        [ShotKey3] = ShotOffset,
    }
end
local function writeShotPayload(cameraData, payload)
    if type(cameraData) ~= "table" then
        return payload
    end
    cameraData[ShotKey0] = payload[ShotKey0]
    cameraData[ShotKey1] = payload[ShotKey1]
    cameraData[ShotKey2] = payload[ShotKey2]
    cameraData[ShotKey3] = payload[ShotKey3]
    return cameraData
end
Gun.StartShooting = function(self, ...)
    local results = table.pack(OriginalGunStartShooting(self, ...))
    if not self or not self.ClientFighter or not self.ClientFighter.IsLocalPlayer then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end
    if results[1] ~= true or results[2] ~= "StartShooting" then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end
    if not State.SilentAim or math.random(1, 100) > State.HitChance then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end

    local targetPlayer, part = acquireTarget(true)
    if not targetPlayer or not part or not part.Parent then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end

    results[3] = writeShotPayload(results[3], buildShotPayload(root.Position, part.Position, part))
    return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
end
local ESPFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
ESPFolder.Name = "_AxonicRivalsESP"
ESPFolder.Parent = Workspace
local ESPObjects = {}

local function removeESP(player)
    local entry = ESPObjects[player]
    if not entry then return end
    if entry.Highlight then entry.Highlight:Destroy() end
    if entry.Gui then entry.Gui:Destroy() end
    ESPObjects[player] = nil
end

local function enemyWeaponName(player)
    if not FighterController or not FighterController.GetFighter then return end
    local ok, fighter = pcall(FighterController.GetFighter, FighterController, player)
    if ok and fighter and fighter.EquippedItem then
        return fighter.EquippedItem.Name
    end
end

local function updateESP()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            local character = player.Character
            local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if not State.ESP or not isEnemy(player) or not isAlive(player) or not head then
                removeESP(player)
            else
                local entry = ESPObjects[player]
                if entry and entry.Character ~= character then
                    removeESP(player)
                    entry = nil
                end
                if not entry then
                    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                    highlight.Name = "AxonicESP"
                    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.72
                    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
                    highlight.Adornee = character
                    highlight.Parent = ESPFolder

                    local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                    gui.Name = "AxonicName"
                    gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 52)
                    gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
                    gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
                    gui.Adornee = head
                    gui.Parent = ESPFolder

                    local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    text.Name = "Text"
                    text.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                    text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    text.TextSize = 14
                    text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
                    text.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.45
                    text.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                    text.TextWrapped = true
                    text.Parent = gui
                    entry = {Character = character, Highlight = highlight, Gui = gui, Label = text}
                    ESPObjects[player] = entry
                end

                local lines = {player.DisplayName}
                local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if root and myRoot then
                    lines[1] = lines[1] .. "  |  " .. math.floor((root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude + .5) .. "m"
                end
                local humanoid = getHumanoid(character)
                local details = {}
                if humanoid then details[#details + 1] = "HP " .. math.floor(humanoid.Health + .5) end
                local weapon = enemyWeaponName(player)
                if weapon then details[#details + 1] = weapon end
                if #details > 0 then lines[#lines + 1] = table.concat(details, "  |  ") end
                entry.Label.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
            end
        end
    end
    for player in pairs(ESPObjects) do
        if not player.Parent then removeESP(player) end
    end
end
connect(Players.PlayerRemoving, removeESP)

local discordGui
local lastViewport

local function makeDiscordPopup()
    local parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    local previous = parent:FindFirstChild("AxonicRivalsInvite")
    if previous then previous:Destroy() end

    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "AxonicRivalsInvite"
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.DisplayOrder = 100
    gui.Parent = parent
    discordGui = gui

    local theme = {
        Window = Color3.fromRGB(13, 13, 15),
        Header = Color3.fromRGB(17, 17, 20),
        Card = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24),
        Button = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 26),
        Hover = Color3.fromRGB(29, 30, 35),
        Border = Color3.fromRGB(40, 41, 47),
        BorderBright = Color3.fromRGB(64, 66, 75),
        Text = Color3.fromRGB(242, 243, 246),
        Muted = Color3.fromRGB(156, 158, 167),
        Faint = Color3.fromRGB(98, 100, 109),
    }

    local function make(class, props, parentObj)
        local instance = Instance.new(class)
        for key, value in pairs(props) do instance[key] = value end
        instance.Parent = parentObj
        return instance
    end

    local function round(obj, amount)
        make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, amount)}, obj)
    end

    local function outline(obj, color, transparency)
        make("UIStroke", {
            Color = color, Transparency = transparency or 0, Thickness = 1,
        }, obj)
    end

    local function label(obj, value, x, y, w, h, size, color, font)
        return make("TextLabel", {
            Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = value,
            TextColor3 = color,
            TextSize = size,
            Font = font or Enum.Font.Gotham,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
        }, obj)
    end

    local width, height = 360, 240
    local panel = make("Frame", {
        Name = "Window",
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5),
        Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5, .5),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Window,
        ClipsDescendants = true,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, gui)
    round(panel, 7)
    outline(panel, theme.BorderBright, .34)
    local scale = make("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, panel)

    local header = make("Frame", {
        Name = "Header",
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 49),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Header,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, panel)
    round(header, 7)
    make("Frame", {
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 7),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -7),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Header,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, header)
    make("Frame", {
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -1),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Border,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, header)

    label(header, "Axonic", 15, 6, 220, 20, 15, theme.Text, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
    label(header, "RIVALS  /  Open Source", 15, 26, 225, 13, 10, theme.Muted)

    local dragHandle = make("TextButton", {
        Name = "DragHandle",
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 1, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "",
        Active = true,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        ZIndex = 2,
    }, header)

    local close = make("TextButton", {
        Name = "Close",
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 11),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(27, 27),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button,
        Text = "×",
        TextSize = 15,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        TextColor3 = theme.Muted,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = 3,
    }, header)
    round(close, 3)
    outline(close, theme.Border, .3)
    close.MouseEnter:Connect(function() close.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Hover end)
    close.MouseLeave:Connect(function() close.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button end)
    close.Activated:Connect(function() gui:Destroy() end)

    local dragging = false
    local dragStart, startPosition, touchInput
    dragHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        local kind = input.UserInputType
        if kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = panel.Position
        touchInput = kind == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input or nil
    end)

    connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
        if not dragging or not panel.Parent then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input ~= touchInput then return end
        local viewport = Workspace.CurrentCamera and Workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
        if not viewport then return end
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        local halfWidth = panel.AbsoluteSize.X * .5
        local halfHeight = panel.AbsoluteSize.Y * .5
        local centerX = viewport.X * startPosition.X.Scale + startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X
        local centerY = viewport.Y * startPosition.Y.Scale + startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        panel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
            math.clamp(centerX, math.min(halfWidth + 8, viewport.X * .5), math.max(viewport.X - halfWidth - 8, viewport.X * .5)),
            math.clamp(centerY, math.min(halfHeight + 8, viewport.Y * .5), math.max(viewport.Y - halfHeight - 8, viewport.Y * .5))
        )
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input == touchInput then
            dragging = false
            touchInput = nil
        end
    end)

    label(panel, "OPEN-SOURCE SCRIPTS", 15, 59, 220, 14, 10, theme.Faint, Enum.Font.GothamBold)

    for index, name in ipairs({"Blox Fruits", "Murder Mystery 2", "RIVALS"}) do
        local row = make("Frame", {
            Name = "Game" .. index,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 79 + (index - 1) * 33),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 29),
            BackgroundColor3 = theme.Card,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
        }, panel)
        round(row, 3)
        outline(row, theme.Border, .27)
        label(row, name, 13, 0, 285, 29, 12, theme.Text, Enum.Font.GothamMedium)
    end

    label(panel, "discord.gg/axonic", 15, 184, 180, 13, 10, theme.Muted)

    local copyButton = make("TextButton", {
        Name = "CopyDiscordInvite",
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 204),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 28),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Text = "COPY DISCORD LINK (CLICK)",
        TextSize = 11,
        TextColor3 = theme.Text,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
    }, panel)
    round(copyButton, 4)
    outline(copyButton, theme.BorderBright, .3)
    copyButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function() copyButton.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Hover end)
    copyButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function() copyButton.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button end)
    copyButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        local clipboard = setclipboard or toclipboard
        local copied = type(clipboard) == "function" and pcall(clipboard, "https://discord.gg/axonic")
        copyButton.Text = copied and "COPIED" or "discord.gg/axonic"
    end)

    local lastViewport
    local function fit()
        local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize
        if not viewport or viewport == lastViewport then return end
        lastViewport = viewport
        scale.Scale = math.clamp(math.min((viewport.X - 24) / width, (viewport.Y - 24) / height), .6, 1)
    end
    fit()
    connect(RunService.RenderStepped, function()
        if gui.Parent then fit() end
    end)
end

pcall(makeDiscordPopup)
local tickAccumulator = 0
local espAccumulator = 0
connect(RunService.RenderStepped, function(dt)
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if FOVCircle then
        local viewport = Camera and Camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.zero
        FOVCircle.Position = Vector2.new(viewport.X * .5, viewport.Y * .5)
        FOVCircle.Radius = State.FOV
        FOVCircle.Visible = State.SilentAim and State.ShowFOV
    end
    tickAccumulator += dt
    if tickAccumulator >= .016 then
        tickAccumulator = 0
        if State.SilentAim then acquireTarget() end
    end
    espAccumulator += dt
    if espAccumulator >= .15 then
        espAccumulator = 0
        pcall(updateESP)
    end
end)

env.AxonicRivalsCleanup = function()
    State.SilentAim = false
    if Gun.StartShooting ~= OriginalGunStartShooting then
        Gun.StartShooting = OriginalGunStartShooting
    end
    for _, c in ipairs(Connections) do
        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
    table.clear(Connections)
    if FOVCircle then pcall(function() FOVCircle:Remove() end) end
    for player in pairs(ESPObjects) do removeESP(player) end
    if ESPFolder then ESPFolder:Destroy() end
    if discordGui then discordGui:Destroy() end
    env.AxonicRivalsCleanup = nil
end

scripts.title: Axonic | Silent Aim Open Source
scripts.author: AxonicHub
scripts.summary: Murder Mystery 2 Gun Silent Aim & Gun Silent Aim Murdery Mystery 2 MM2 MurderMystery2 murder mystery 2
scripts.code:
-- Join Discord For More Open Sources, Coming Soon https://discord.gg/axonic

repeat
    task.wait()
until game:IsLoaded() and game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local env = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
if type(env.AxonicMM2SilentStop) == "function" then
    pcall(env.AxonicMM2SilentStop)
end
local Connections = {}
local function track(connection)
    Connections[#Connections + 1] = connection
    return connection
end
local function connect(signal, callback)
    return track(signal:Connect(callback))
end
local State = {
    Running = true,
    GunAimV2 = true,
    GunRageMode = false,
    GunAimTargetPart = "Head",
    KnifeAim = true,
    KnifeAimV2 = false,
    KnifeRageMode = false,
    KnifeAimTargetPart = "Head",
    KnifeAimFOV = 220,
    RoundCombatSuspended = true,
    WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0,
}
local BypassWeaponAimRedirect = false
local OriginalWorkspaceNamecall
local OriginalWorkspaceRaycastFunction
local WeaponServiceMouseRaw
local WeaponServiceTargetRaw
local getIgnoredParts
local function safeRequire(module)
    if not module or not module:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
    local ok, value = pcall(require, module)
    return ok and value or nil
end
local modules = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules", 15)
local CurrentRoundClient = modules and safeRequire(modules:WaitForChild("CurrentRoundClient", 15))
local clientServices = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ClientServices", 15)
local WeaponService = clientServices and safeRequire(clientServices:WaitForChild("WeaponService", 15))
local OriginalWeaponService = {}
if type(WeaponService) == "table" then
    OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame = WeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame
    OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition = WeaponService.GetTargetPosition
end
local function premiumGunAimIsEnabled() return false end
local function getGunRageShotCFrames() return nil, nil, nil end
local function isKnifeWallBangRay() return false end
local function getPremiumGunAimCFrame() return nil, nil, nil end

-- Round data
local function getRoundDataRemote()
    local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    local gameplay = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")
    local remote = gameplay and gameplay:FindFirstChild("GetCurrentPlayerData")
    if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then return remote end
    return nil
end
local function getRoundData()
    if type(CurrentRoundClient) == "table" then
        if type(CurrentRoundClient.PlayerData) == "table" and next(CurrentRoundClient.PlayerData) then return CurrentRoundClient.PlayerData end
        if type(CurrentRoundClient.GetLatestPlayerData) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(CurrentRoundClient.GetLatestPlayerData)
            if ok and type(result) == "table" then return result end
        end
    end
    local remote = getRoundDataRemote()
    if remote then
        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            return remote:InvokeServer()
        end)
        if ok and type(result) == "table" then return result end
    end
    return {}
end
local function hasWeaponTool(player, weapon)
    for _, container in ipairs({ player.Character, player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") }) do
        if container then
            for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Tool") then
                    local lowerToolName = string.lower(child.Name)
                    if weapon == "Knife" and (child:FindFirstChild("Stab") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeClient") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeLocal")
                            or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Knife")) then
                        return true
                    end
                    if weapon == "Gun" and (child:FindFirstChild("IsGun") or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Gun") or lowerToolName == "gun") then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function hasEquippedWeapon(weapon)
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return false end
    for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Tool") then
            local lowerToolName = string.lower(child.Name)
            if weapon == "Knife" and (child:FindFirstChild("Stab") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeClient") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeLocal")
                    or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Knife")) then
                return true
            end
            if weapon == "Gun" and (child:FindFirstChild("IsGun") or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Gun") or lowerToolName == "gun") then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function getPlayerRole(player, playerData)
    local data = playerData[player.Name]
    if hasWeaponTool(player, "Knife") then return "Murderer", data end
    if hasWeaponTool(player, "Gun") then return "Sheriff", data end
    if type(data) == "table" and data.Dead ~= true and type(data.Role) == "string" then return data.Role, data end
    return nil, data
end
local function getRoundIntel()
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    local intel = { Murderer = {}, Sheriff = {}, Innocent = {}, }
    local alive = 0
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local role, data = getPlayerRole(player, playerData)
        local isAlive = type(data) ~= "table" or data.Dead ~= true
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then isAlive = false end
        if role == "Hero" then role = "Sheriff" end
        if isAlive then
            alive += 1
            if role == "Murderer" or role == "Sheriff" or role == "Innocent" then
                table.insert(intel[role], player.Name)
            end
        end
    end
    return intel, alive
end
local function isPlaying()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    local localData = playerData[LocalPlayer.Name]
    if type(localData) == "table" and localData.Dead == true then return false end
    if hasWeaponTool(LocalPlayer, "Gun") or hasWeaponTool(LocalPlayer, "Knife") then return true end
    if type(localData) == "table" then
        local role = localData.Role
        if role == "Murderer" or role == "Sheriff" or role == "Hero" or role == "Innocent" then return true end
    end
    local aliveAttribute = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Alive")
    if aliveAttribute ~= nil then return aliveAttribute == true end
    return humanoid.Health > 0
end
local function getRoot()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function getInstanceRoot(instance)
    if not instance then return nil end
    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then return instance end
    if instance:IsA("Model") then return instance.PrimaryPart or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) end
    if instance:IsA("Tool") then return instance:FindFirstChild("Handle") or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) end
    return instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
end
local function findMurderer()
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            local role = getPlayerRole(player, playerData)
            if role == "Murderer" then return player end
        end
    end
    return nil
end
local function playerIsAlive(player, playerData)
    if not player or not player.Character then return false end
    local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
    local data = playerData and playerData[player.Name]
    return type(data) ~= "table" or data.Dead ~= true
end
local getIgnoredParts
local function getCharacterKnifeAimPart(character, mode)
    if not character then return nil end
    if mode == "Torso" then
        return character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or character:FindFirstChild("Head") or getInstanceRoot(character)
    end
    return character:FindFirstChild("Head") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        or character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or getInstanceRoot(character)
end
local function getCrosshair()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return nil end
    local mouseLocation = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local x = mouseLocation.X
    local y = mouseLocation.Y
    local playerScripts = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
    local mouseLock = playerScripts and playerScripts:FindFirstChild("MouseLock")
    if mouseLock and mouseLock:GetAttribute("Enabled") == true and UserInputService.PreferredInput ~= Enum.PreferredInput.Gamepad then
        local viewportSize = camera.ViewportSize
        x = viewportSize.X / 2
        y = viewportSize.Y / 2
    end
    return Vector2.new(x, y)
end
local function hasClearShot(origin, targetPart)
    if not origin or not targetPart then return false end
    local direction = targetPart.Position - origin
    if direction.Magnitude <= 0.1 then return true end
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = getIgnoredParts()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    BypassWeaponAimRedirect = true
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        return workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
    end)
    BypassWeaponAimRedirect = false
    if not ok then return false end
    return not result or result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetPart.Parent)
end

-- Gun
local function getGunTarget(allowWalls)
    local murderer = findMurderer()
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    if not murderer or not playerIsAlive(murderer, playerData) or not murderer.Character then return nil, nil, nil end
    local character = murderer.Character
    local preferred
    if State.GunAimTargetPart == "Torso" then
        preferred = { character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), character:FindFirstChild("Torso"), character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
            character:FindFirstChild("Head"), }
    else
        preferred = { character:FindFirstChild("Head"), character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
            character:FindFirstChild("Torso"), }
    end
    local root = getRoot()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local origin = camera and camera.CFrame.Position or (root and root.Position)
    local targetPart
    for _, part in ipairs(preferred) do
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            if allowWalls or not origin or hasClearShot(origin, part) then
                targetPart = part
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if not targetPart then return nil, murderer, nil end
    local velocity = targetPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
    if velocity.Magnitude > 120 then velocity = velocity.Unit * 120 end
    local distance = root and (targetPart.Position - root.Position).Magnitude or 0
    local leadTime = math.clamp(0.035 + distance / 2200, 0.035, 0.09)
    local predicted = targetPart.Position + velocity * leadTime
    return CFrame.new(predicted), murderer, targetPart
end
local KnifeAimStickyPlayer = nil
local KnifeAimStickyUntil = 0

-- Knife
local function getKnifeTarget(requireVisible)
    local root = getRoot()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local aimPoint = getCrosshair()
    if not root or not camera or not aimPoint then
        KnifeAimStickyPlayer = nil
        return nil, nil, nil
    end
    local viewOrigin = camera.CFrame.Position
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    local now = os.clock()
    local fov = math.max(40, tonumber(State.KnifeAimFOV) or 220)
    local function evaluate(player, sticky)
        if player == LocalPlayer or not playerIsAlive(player, playerData) or not player.Character then return nil end
        local role = getPlayerRole(player, playerData)
        if role == "Murderer" then return nil end
        local part = getCharacterKnifeAimPart( player.Character, State.KnifeAimTargetPart )
        if not part then return nil end
        local screenPosition, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        if not onScreen or screenPosition.Z <= 0 then return nil end
        local screenDistance = (Vector2.new(screenPosition.X, screenPosition.Y) - aimPoint).Magnitude
        local allowedFov = sticky and (fov * 1.25) or fov
        if screenDistance > allowedFov then return nil end
        if requireVisible and not hasClearShot(viewOrigin, part) then return nil end
        local distance = (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
        return part, screenDistance + distance * 0.025, distance
    end
    if KnifeAimStickyPlayer and now <= KnifeAimStickyUntil then
        local part, _, distance = evaluate(KnifeAimStickyPlayer, true)
        if part then
            local velocity = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
            if velocity.Magnitude > 100 then velocity = velocity.Unit * 100 end
            local leadTime = math.clamp(distance / 180, 0.045, 0.28)
            return CFrame.new(part.Position + velocity * leadTime), KnifeAimStickyPlayer, part
        end
    end
    local bestTarget
    local bestPart
    local bestDistance
    local bestScore = math.huge
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local part, score, distance = evaluate(player, false)
        if part and score < bestScore then
            bestTarget = player
            bestPart = part
            bestDistance = distance
            bestScore = score
        end
    end
    if not bestTarget or not bestPart then
        KnifeAimStickyPlayer = nil
        KnifeAimStickyUntil = 0
        return nil, nil, nil
    end
    KnifeAimStickyPlayer = bestTarget
    KnifeAimStickyUntil = now + 0.28
    local velocity = bestPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
    if velocity.Magnitude > 100 then velocity = velocity.Unit * 100 end
    local leadTime = math.clamp((bestDistance or 0) / 180, 0.045, 0.28)
    local targetPosition = bestPart.Position + velocity * leadTime
    return CFrame.new(targetPosition), bestTarget, bestPart

local function isWeaponRay(origin, direction)

    if os.clock() > (State.WeaponRayWindowUntil or 0) then return false end
    local magnitude = direction.Magnitude

    if not camera then return false end

    if type(getcallingscript) == "function" then

            if string.find(path, "camera", 1, true) or string.find(path, "zoom", 1, true) or string.find(path, "occlusion", 1, true) then
                return false

            if string.find(path, "gun", 1, true) or string.find(path, "weapon", 1, true) or string.find(path, "shoot", 1, true)

local function raycastToTarget(targetPart)

        if child:IsA("Accessory") or child:IsA("Tool") then

    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    local right = targetPart.CFrame.RightVector
    local forward = targetPart.CFrame.LookVector
    local offsets = { -forward * 5, forward * 5, right * 5, -right * 5, Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), Vector3.new(0, -4, 0), }
    for _, offset in ipairs(offsets) do
        local origin = targetPosition + offset
        local direction = targetPosition - origin
        if direction.Magnitude > 0.1 then
            local ok, result = pcall(raycastForGunAimV2, origin, direction, params )
            if ok and result and result.Instance and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetCharacter) then return result end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

                args[2] = targetCFrame
                return true

        else
            args[2] = CFrame.new(targetPosition)
            return true
        end
    end
    local function replaceArgument(index)
        local valueType = typeof(args[index])
        if valueType == "Vector3" then
            args[index] = targetPosition
            return true
        elseif valueType == "CFrame" then
            args[index] = CFrame.new(targetPosition)
            return true
        elseif valueType == "Ray" then
            local originalRay = args[index]
            local direction = targetPosition - originalRay.Origin
            if direction.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                args[index] = Ray.new(originalRay.Origin, direction.Unit * math.max(originalRay.Direction.Magnitude, direction.Magnitude) )
                return true
            end
        elseif valueType == "Instance" and args[index] ~= LocalPlayer.Character and targetPart then
            args[index] = targetPart
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    if argumentCount >= 2 and replaceArgument(2) then return true end
    for index = 1, argumentCount do
        if index ~= 2 and replaceArgument(index) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

    if argumentCount >= 2 and typeof(args[1]) == "Vector3" and typeof(args[2]) == "Vector3" then
        if wallBang and spoofedOrigin then
            args[1] = spoofedOrigin.Position
        end
        args[2] = args[2].Magnitude <= 5 and throwDirection or targetPosition
        return true
    end
    for index = 1, argumentCount do
        local valueType = typeof(args[index])
        if valueType == "CFrame" then
            if wallBang and index == 1 and argumentCount > 1 and spoofedOrigin then
                args[index] = spoofedOrigin
            else

-- Weapon hooks
local function installNamecallHook()
    if OriginalWorkspaceNamecall or type(hookmetamethod) ~= "function" or type(getnamecallmethod) ~= "function" then return end
    local namecallHook
    namecallHook = function(self, ...)
        local method = getnamecallmethod()
        local args = { ... }
        local argumentCount = select("#", ...)
        if not State.RoundCombatSuspended and (State.KnifeAim or State.KnifeRageMode or (State.KnifeAimV2))
            and (method == "FireServer" or method == "InvokeServer") and isKnifeThrowRemote(self) then
            local rewritten = rewriteKnifeArgs(args, argumentCount)
            if rewritten then
                local dispatchResults = table.pack(pcall(sendWeaponRemote, self, method, args, argumentCount ))
                if not dispatchResults[1] then return nil end
                State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                return table.unpack(dispatchResults, 2, dispatchResults.n)
            end
            State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
            return sendWeaponRemote(self, method, args, argumentCount)
        end
        if not State.RoundCombatSuspended and (State.GunAimV2 or State.GunRageMode or premiumGunAimIsEnabled())
            and (method == "FireServer" or method == "InvokeServer") and isGunShotRemote(self) then
            local rewritten = rewriteGunArgs(args, argumentCount)
            if rewritten then
                local dispatchResults = table.pack(pcall(sendWeaponRemote, self, method, args, argumentCount ))
                if not dispatchResults[1] then return nil end
                State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                return table.unpack(dispatchResults, 2, dispatchResults.n)
            end
            State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
            return sendWeaponRemote(self, method, args, argumentCount)
        end
        if self == workspace and method == "Raycast" and not BypassWeaponAimRedirect and not State.RoundCombatSuspended and isPlaying() then
            if hasEquippedWeapon("Gun") and not State.GunRageMode and (State.GunAimV2 or premiumGunAimIsEnabled()) and isWeaponRay(args[1], args[2]) then
                local result = getGunRayHit(args[3])
                if result then
                    State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                    return result
                end
            end
            if hasEquippedWeapon("Knife") and (State.KnifeAim or State.KnifeRageMode or (State.KnifeAimV2))
                and ((State.KnifeRageMode and isKnifeWallBangRay(args[1], args[2])) or (not State.KnifeRageMode and isWeaponRay(args[1], args[2]))) then
                local result = getKnifeRayHit()
                if result then
                    State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                    return result
                end
            end
        end
        return callOriginal(self, method, args, argumentCount)
    end
    OriginalWorkspaceNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", type(newcclosure) == "function" and newcclosure(namecallHook) or namecallHook )
end

local function installWeaponHook()
    if type(WeaponService) ~= "table" or WeaponService.AxonicAimHooked then return end
    WeaponService.AxonicAimHooked = true
    local function redirectedTargetCFrame()
        if State.RoundCombatSuspended then return nil end
        if os.clock() > (State.WeaponRayWindowUntil or 0) then return nil end
        if (State.GunAimV2 or premiumGunAimIsEnabled()) and not State.GunRageMode and isPlaying() and hasEquippedWeapon("Gun") then
            local targetCFrame = getGunTargetCFrame()
            if targetCFrame then return targetCFrame end
        end
        if (State.KnifeAim or State.KnifeRageMode or (State.KnifeAimV2)) and isPlaying() and hasEquippedWeapon("Knife") then
            local targetCFrame = getKnifeTarget(State.KnifeRageMode ~= true)
            if targetCFrame then return targetCFrame end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local mouseWrapper
    local targetWrapper
    mouseWrapper = function(...)
        local redirected = redirectedTargetCFrame()
        if redirected then return redirected end
        local raw = WeaponServiceMouseRaw or OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame
        if type(raw) == "function" then return raw(...) end
        return CFrame.new()
    end
    targetWrapper = function(...)
        local redirected = redirectedTargetCFrame()
        if redirected then return redirected end
        local raw = WeaponServiceTargetRaw or OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition
        if type(raw) == "function" then return raw(...) end
        return CFrame.new()
    end
    if type(newcclosure) == "function" then
        mouseWrapper = newcclosure(mouseWrapper)
        targetWrapper = newcclosure(targetWrapper)
    end
    local hooked = false
    if type(hookfunction) == "function" and type(OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame) == "function"
        and type(OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition) == "function" then
        local okMouse, rawMouse = pcall(hookfunction, OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame, mouseWrapper )
        local okTarget, rawTarget = pcall(hookfunction, OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition, targetWrapper )
        if okMouse and okTarget and type(rawMouse) == "function" and type(rawTarget) == "function" then
            WeaponServiceMouseRaw = rawMouse
            WeaponServiceTargetRaw = rawTarget
            hooked = true
        end
    end
    if not hooked then
        WeaponServiceMouseRaw = OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame
        WeaponServiceTargetRaw = OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition
        WeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame = mouseWrapper
        WeaponService.GetTargetPosition = targetWrapper
    end
end

--// Presets -------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function merge(base, over)
	local out = {}
	for k, v in pairs(base) do
		out[k] = (type(v) == "table") and merge(v, {}) or v
	end
	for k, v in pairs(over) do
		if type(v) == "table" then
			out[k] = merge(out[k] or {}, v)
		else
			out[k] = v
		end
	end
	return out
end

--// Create the effects ---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function make(className, name, props)
	local old = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
	if old then old:Destroy() end
	local inst = Instance.new(className)
	inst.Name = name
	for k, v in pairs(props) do
		inst[k] = v
	end
	inst.Parent = Lighting
	return inst
end

	g.DisplayOrder = order
