-- Vignette: four gradient edges
local vigGui = newGui("SP_Vignette", 50)
local vigEdges = {}
local function edge(anchor, position, size, rotation)
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0
	f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	f.AnchorPoint = anchor
	f.Position = position
	f.Size = size
	local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	g.Rotation = rotation
	g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1)
	g.Parent = f
	f.Parent = vigGui
	table.insert(vigEdges, f)
end
edge(Vector2.new(0, 0), UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.3), 90)
edge(Vector2.new(0, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.3), 270)
edge(Vector2.new(0, 0), UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 1), 0)
edge(Vector2.new(1, 0), UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 1), 180)

local function setVignette(strengthValue)
	local t = 1 - math.clamp(strengthValue, 0, 1)
	for _, f in ipairs(vigEdges) do
		f.BackgroundTransparency = t
	end
end

local flareGui = newGui("SP_Flare", 40)

local function flareElement(k, size, color, alpha, ring, streak)
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0
	f.BackgroundColor3 = color
	f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	local e = { frame = f, k = k, size = size, alpha = alpha, streak = streak }
	if streak then
		local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
		})
		g.Parent = f
	else
		local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
		c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
		c.Parent = f
		if ring then
			local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
			s.Color = color
			s.Thickness = 3
			s.Transparency = 1
			s.Parent = f
			f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			e.stroke = s
		end
	end
	f.Parent = flareGui
	table.insert(flareParts, e)
end

	f.Parent = rainGui
	drops[i] = {
		frame = f,
		x = math.random() * 1.2 - 0.1,
		y = math.random(),
		speed = 1.1 + math.random() * 0.9,
		on = false,
	}
end

local function updateRain(dt, amount, slantDeg, vp)
	local count = math.floor(RAIN_DROPS * math.clamp(amount, 0, 1))
	local drift = math.tan(math.rad(slantDeg)) * (vp.Y / math.max(vp.X, 1))
	for i, d in ipairs(drops) do
		if i <= count then
			if not d.on then
				d.on = true
				d.frame.Visible = true
			end
			d.y += d.speed * dt
			d.x += d.speed * dt * drift
			if d.y > 1.1 then
				d.y = -0.1
				d.x = math.random() * 1.2 - 0.1
			end
			if d.x > 1.1 then d.x = -0.1 end
			d.frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(d.x, d.y)
			d.frame.Rotation = -slantDeg
		elseif d.on then
			d.on = false
			d.frame.Visible = false
		end
	end
end

--// Hide / restore the game's own post effects -------------------------------------------------------
local stashed = {}

local function stashExisting()
	if not REPLACE_EXISTING_EFFECTS then return end
	for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
		if (child:IsA("PostEffect") or child:IsA("Atmosphere")) and child.Name:sub(1, 3) ~= "SP_" then
			table.insert(stashed, child)
			child.Parent = nil
		end
	end
end

local function restoreStashed()
	for _, inst in ipairs(stashed) do
		inst.Parent = Lighting
	end
	table.clear(stashed)
end

--// Clouds / sky / water (capture originals, restore on disable) ---------------------------------------
local clouds, cloudsOrig, cloudsOwn
local function ensureClouds()
	if clouds and clouds.Parent then return end
	clouds = terrain:FindFirstChildOfClass("Clouds")
	cloudsOwn = false
	if clouds then
		cloudsOrig = { Cover = clouds.Cover, Density = clouds.Density, Color = clouds.Color, Enabled = clouds.Enabled }
	else
		clouds = Instance.new("Clouds")
		clouds.Name = "SP_Clouds"
		clouds.Parent = terrain
		cloudsOwn = true
	end
end
local function restoreClouds()
	if not (clouds and clouds.Parent) then return end
	if cloudsOwn then
        clouds:Destroy()
        clouds = nil
	else
		for k, v in pairs(cloudsOrig) do
			clouds[k] = v
		end
	end
end

local sky, skyOrig, skyOwn
local function ensureSky()
	if sky and sky.Parent then return end
	sky = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")
	skyOwn = false
	if sky then

			MoonAngularSize = sky.MoonAngularSize, CelestialBodiesShown = sky.CelestialBodiesShown,

--// Helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function approach(inst, prop, target, a)
	local cur = inst[prop]
	if typeof(cur) == "Color3" then
		inst[prop] = cur:Lerp(target, a)
	else
		inst[prop] = cur + (target - cur) * a
	end
end

local function applyProps(inst, tbl, a)
	for prop, value in pairs(tbl) do
		approach(inst, prop, value, a)
	end
end

local scratch = { Lighting = {}, Bloom = {}, Color = {}, SunRays = {}, DOF = {}, Atmo = {}, Water = {} }
local function fill(dst, src)
	for k in pairs(dst) do dst[k] = nil end
	for k, v in pairs(src) do dst[k] = v end
	return dst
end

local function isUnderwater(pos)
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		local cell = terrain:WorldToCell(pos)
		local center = terrain:CellCenterToWorld(cell.X, cell.Y, cell.Z)
		local region = Region3.new(center - Vector3.one * 2, center + Vector3.one * 2)
		local materials, occupancy = terrain:ReadVoxels(region, 4)
		if materials[1][1][1] ~= Enum.Material.Water then
			return false
		end
		local surfaceY = (center.Y - 2) + occupancy[1][1][1] * 4
		return pos.Y < surfaceY
	end)
	return ok and result or false
end

-- Checks how enclosed the camera is and whether the sun is visible (runs ~7x per second)
local SKY_RAYS = {
	Vector3.new(0, 1, 0),
	Vector3.new(0.6, 1, 0).Unit,
	Vector3.new(-0.6, 1, 0).Unit,
	Vector3.new(0, 1, 0.6).Unit,
	Vector3.new(0, 1, -0.6).Unit,
}
local function sampleSurroundings()
	local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
	local hits = 0
	for _, dir in ipairs(SKY_RAYS) do
		if Workspace:Raycast(origin, dir * 70, rayParams) then
			hits += 1
		end
	end
	indoorTarget = hits / #SKY_RAYS
	local sunDir = Lighting:GetSunDirection()
	sunVisible = sunDir.Y > -0.05 and Workspace:Raycast(origin, sunDir * 1500, rayParams) == nil
end

local function refreshFlags()
	local m = config.Master
	bloom.Enabled = m and features.Bloom
	grade.Enabled = m and features.ColorGrade
	sunRays.Enabled = m and features.SunRays
	dof.Enabled = m and features.DepthOfField
	if not (m and features.MotionBlur) then
		motionBlur.Enabled = false
		motionBlur.Size = 0
	end
	atmosphere.Parent = (m and features.Atmosphere) and Lighting or nil
	if not m then
		waterGrade.Enabled = false
		waterBlur.Enabled = false
		flashGrade.Enabled = false
	end
	vigGui.Enabled = m
	barsGui.Enabled = m
	rainGui.Enabled = m
	flareGui.Enabled = m and features.LensFlare
end

local function setWeather(name)
	currentWeather = name
	features.Weather = true
	if refreshUI then refreshUI() end
end

local function pickRandomWeather()
	local pool = {}
	for _, n in ipairs(WEATHER_ORDER) do
		if n ~= currentWeather then
			table.insert(pool, n)
		end
	end
	setWeather(pool[math.random(#pool)])
end

local function updateFlare(dt, sunDir, vp)
	local target = 0
	if features.LensFlare then
		local pos, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(camera.CFrame.Position + sunDir * 1000)
		if onScreen and pos.Z > 0 and sunVisible then
			lastSunPx = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)
			local fromCenter = (lastSunPx - vp / 2).Magnitude / math.max(vp.Magnitude / 2, 1)
			target = math.clamp(1.3 - fromCenter * 1.3, 0, 1)
			target *= math.clamp(sunDir.Y * 6 + 0.3, 0, 1)
			target *= (1 - 0.85 * wx.cover)
			target *= (1 - uw)
		end
	end
	flareAmt += (target - flareAmt) * (1 - math.exp(-dt * 8))
	flareGui.Enabled = flareAmt > 0.01
	if not flareGui.Enabled then return end

	local axis = vp / 2 - lastSunPx
	for _, e in ipairs(flareParts) do
		local p = lastSunPx + axis * e.k
		e.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.X, p.Y)
		if e.streak then
			e.frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(vp.X * 0.7, 5)
		else
			local s = e.size * vp.Y
			e.frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(s, s)
		end
		local tr = 1 - flareAmt * e.alpha
		if e.stroke then
			e.stroke.Transparency = tr
		else
			e.frame.BackgroundTransparency = tr
		end
	end
end

--// Main loop -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(rawDt)
	if not config.Master then return end
	local activeCamera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not activeCamera then return end
    if camera ~= activeCamera then
        camera = activeCamera
        baseFov = camera.FieldOfView
        lastLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
        fovTouched = false
    end

	local dt = math.min(rawDt, 0.1)
    local instantFPS = 1 / math.max(rawDt, 1 / 240)
    fpsAverage += (instantFPS - fpsAverage) * (1 - math.exp(-dt * 1.8))
    qualityCheckTimer += dt
    if autoQuality and qualityCheckTimer >= 2 then
        qualityCheckTimer = 0
        if fpsAverage < 42 then
            qualityScale = math.max(0.45, qualityScale - 0.10)
        elseif fpsAverage > 58 then
            qualityScale = math.min(0.72, qualityScale + 0.04)
        end
        if refreshUI then refreshUI() end
    end
    fpsUiTimer += dt
	local preset = PRESETS[currentPreset]
	local S = strength
	local a = 1 - math.exp(-dt * TRANSITION_SPEED)
	local fa = 1 - math.exp(-dt * FOCUS_SPEED)
	local vp = camera.ViewportSize

	-- Clock + sun
	if features.DayNightCycle then
		Lighting.ClockTime = (Lighting.ClockTime + dt * CLOCK_SPEED) % 24
	end
	local sunDir = Lighting:GetSunDirection()
	local sunHeight = sunDir.Y
	local dayFactor = features.NightAdapt and math.clamp(sunHeight * 2 + 0.2, 0, 1) or 1
	local night = math.clamp(-sunHeight * 3.5, 0, 1)
	local golden = math.clamp(1 - math.abs(sunHeight) / 0.3, 0, 1)
	local tg = features.TimeGrade and 1 or 0

	timeUiTimer -= dt
	if timeUiTimer <= 0 and timeSlider then
		timeUiTimer = 0.25
		timeSlider.set(Lighting.ClockTime)
	end

	-- Weather blending
	local wTarget = features.Weather and WEATHER[currentWeather] or WEATHER.Clear
	local wa = 1 - math.exp(-dt * WEATHER_SPEED)
	for k, v in pairs(wTarget) do
		wx[k] += (v - wx[k]) * wa
	end
	if features.AutoWeather then
		weatherTimer -= dt
		if weatherTimer <= 0 then
			weatherTimer = math.random(AUTO_WEATHER_MIN, AUTO_WEATHER_MAX)
			pickRandomWeather()
		end
	end

	-- Surroundings (indoors / sun visibility)
	sampleTimer -= dt
	if sampleTimer <= 0 then
		sampleTimer = 0.15 / math.max(qualityScale, 0.45)
		sampleSurroundings()
	end
	indoor += (indoorTarget - indoor) * (1 - math.exp(-dt * 3))

	-- Underwater (checked 10x per second)
	waterTimer += dt
	if waterTimer > (0.1 / math.max(qualityScale, 0.45)) then
		waterTimer = 0
		underwater = features.UnderwaterFX and isUnderwater(camera.CFrame.Position)
	end
	uw += ((underwater and 1 or 0) - uw) * (1 - math.exp(-dt * 4))
	waterGrade.Enabled = underwater
	waterBlur.Enabled = underwater

	-- Low health amount (0 = healthy, 1 = nearly dead)
	local danger = 0
	if features.LowHealthFX and humanoid and humanoid.Parent and humanoid.MaxHealth > 0 then
		local frac = humanoid.Health / humanoid.MaxHealth
		danger = math.clamp((0.35 - frac) / 0.35, 0, 1)
	end

	-- Lightning
	if features.Weather and wx.storm > 0.6 then
		boltTimer -= dt
		if boltTimer <= 0 then
			flash = 1
			boltTimer = 4 + math.random() * 10
			pendingFlash = (math.random() < 0.55) and 0.12 or nil
		end
	end
	if pendingFlash then
		pendingFlash -= dt
		if pendingFlash <= 0 then
			flash = math.max(flash, 0.75)
			pendingFlash = nil
		end
	end
	flash *= math.exp(-dt * 8)
	local flashAmt = flash * (1 - indoor * 0.7)
	flashGrade.Enabled = flashAmt > 0.01
	if flashGrade.Enabled then
		flashGrade.Brightness = flashAmt * 0.35
		flashGrade.Contrast = flashAmt * 0.25
	end

	-- Auto exposure (eye adaptation): brighter indoors, darker when staring at the sun
	local exposureTarget = 0
	if features.AutoExposure then
		exposureTarget += indoor * 0.5 * (0.4 + 0.6 * dayFactor)
		local facing = math.max(0, camera.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(sunDir)) ^ 6
		exposureTarget -= facing * 0.55 * dayFactor * (sunVisible and 1 or 0) * (1 - 0.8 * wx.cover)
	end
	eyeExposure += (exposureTarget - eyeExposure) * (1 - math.exp(-dt * 1.2))

	-- Lighting properties (+ weather + time of day)
	local lt = fill(scratch.Lighting, preset.Lighting)
	lt.Brightness = lt.Brightness * (1 - 0.4 * wx.gloom)
	lt.ExposureCompensation = lt.ExposureCompensation - 0.35 * wx.gloom + eyeExposure
	lt.EnvironmentSpecularScale = math.min(1, lt.EnvironmentSpecularScale + 0.3 * wx.rain)
	lt.Ambient = lt.Ambient:Lerp(GREY_AMBIENT, wx.gloom * 0.45)
	lt.OutdoorAmbient = lt.OutdoorAmbient:Lerp(GREY_AMBIENT, wx.gloom * 0.45)
	if tg > 0 then
		lt.Ambient = lt.Ambient:Lerp(NIGHT_AMBIENT, night * 0.55)
		lt.OutdoorAmbient = lt.OutdoorAmbient:Lerp(NIGHT_OUTDOOR, night * 0.7)
		lt.ColorShift_Top = lt.ColorShift_Top:Lerp(WARM_SUN, golden * 0.7)
		lt.ColorShift_Bottom = lt.ColorShift_Bottom:Lerp(WARM_BOUNCE, golden * 0.5)
	end
	applyProps(Lighting, lt, a)

	-- Bloom (stronger at night)
	if features.Bloom then
		local t = fill(scratch.Bloom, preset.Bloom)
		t.Intensity = t.Intensity * S * (1 + (1 - dayFactor) * 0.6)
		applyProps(bloom, t, a)
	end

	-- Color grading (strength, weather, time of day, rainbow, low health)
	if features.ColorGrade then
		local t = fill(scratch.Color, preset.Color)
		t.Brightness = t.Brightness * S
		t.Contrast = t.Contrast * S
		t.Saturation = t.Saturation * S
		t.TintColor = WHITE:Lerp(t.TintColor, math.min(S, 1))

		t.Saturation = t.Saturation - 0.35 * wx.gloom - 0.2 * wx.snow
		t.TintColor = t.TintColor:Lerp(COOL_GREY, wx.gloom * 0.45 + wx.snow * 0.2)

		if tg > 0 then
			t.TintColor = t.TintColor:Lerp(GOLDEN_TINT, golden * 0.5)
			t.TintColor = t.TintColor:Lerp(NIGHT_TINT, night * 0.45)
			t.Saturation = t.Saturation + golden * 0.12 - night * 0.1
			t.Contrast = t.Contrast + golden * 0.05
		end
		if features.RainbowTint then
			t.TintColor = Color3.fromHSV((os.clock() * 0.05) % 1, 0.3, 1)
		end
		if danger > 0 then
			t.Saturation = t.Saturation - danger * 0.6
			t.TintColor = t.TintColor:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 110), danger * 0.6)
		end
		t.Saturation = math.clamp(t.Saturation, -1, 1)
		t.Contrast = math.clamp(t.Contrast, -1, 1)
		t.Brightness = math.clamp(t.Brightness, -1, 1)
		applyProps(grade, t, a)
	end

	-- God rays fade after sunset and behind clouds
	if features.SunRays then
		local t = fill(scratch.SunRays, preset.SunRays)
		t.Intensity = math.clamp(t.Intensity * S * dayFactor * (1 - 0.8 * wx.cover), 0, 1)
		applyProps(sunRays, t, a)
	end

	-- Atmosphere (weather fog, golden/blue hour, underwater fog)
	if features.Atmosphere then
		local t = fill(scratch.Atmo, preset.Atmosphere)
		t.Density = math.clamp(t.Density * S + 0.45 * wx.fog + 0.08 * wx.gloom + 0.45 * uw, 0, 1)
		t.Haze = t.Haze + 3 * wx.fog + wx.gloom
		t.Glare = t.Glare * (1 - 0.85 * wx.cover)
		if tg > 0 then
			t.Color = t.Color:Lerp(GOLD_FOG, golden * 0.6):Lerp(NIGHT_FOG, night * 0.8)
			t.Decay = t.Decay:Lerp(GOLD_DECAY, golden * 0.6):Lerp(NIGHT_DECAY, night * 0.8)
			t.Glare = t.Glare + golden * 0.6
		end
		t.Color = t.Color:Lerp(GREY_FOG, wx.gloom * 0.7):Lerp(WATER_FOG, uw * 0.85)
		t.Decay = t.Decay:Lerp(GREY_DECAY, wx.gloom * 0.7):Lerp(WATER_DECAY, uw * 0.85)
		applyProps(atmosphere, t, a)
	end

	-- Depth of field with auto-focus (raycasts from the camera)
	if features.DepthOfField then
		local t = fill(scratch.DOF, preset.DOF)
		t.FarIntensity = t.FarIntensity * S
		t.NearIntensity = t.NearIntensity * S
		if features.AutoFocus then
			local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
			local hit = Workspace:Raycast(origin, camera.CFrame.LookVector * MAX_FOCUS, rayParams)
			local dist = hit and (hit.Position - origin).Magnitude or MAX_FOCUS
			t.FocusDistance = dist
			t.InFocusRadius = math.clamp(dist * 0.5, 8, 120)
			t.NearIntensity = 0 -- don't blur your own character
		end
		applyProps(dof, t, fa)
	end

	-- Volumetric clouds (cover/density from weather, color from time of day)
	if features.Clouds then
		ensureClouds()
		clouds.Enabled = true
		clouds.Cover = wx.cover
		clouds.Density = wx.density
		local cc = WHITE:Lerp(CLOUD_GOLD, golden * 0.8 * tg)
		cc = cc:Lerp(CLOUD_NIGHT, night * 0.9 * tg)
		cc = cc:Lerp(CLOUD_GLOOM, wx.gloom * 0.75)
		approach(clouds, "Color", cc, a)
	end

	-- Stars, sun and moon
	if features.Celestial then
		ensureSky()
		sky.CelestialBodiesShown = true
		sky.StarCount = math.floor(( ((currentPreset == "StarryNight") or (currentPreset == "Aurora")) and 9000 or 7000 ) * night * (1 - 0.55 * wx.cover))
		sky.SunAngularSize = 21 + golden * 12
		sky.MoonAngularSize = 15
	end

	-- Water shader (waves get bigger in rain / storms)
	if features.WaterFX then
		local t = fill(scratch.Water, preset.Water)
		t.WaterWaveSize = math.min(1, t.WaterWaveSize + 0.35 * wx.storm + 0.12 * wx.rain)
		t.WaterWaveSpeed = t.WaterWaveSpeed + 14 * wx.storm + 5 * wx.rain
		t.WaterColor = t.WaterColor:Lerp(GREY_WATER, wx.gloom * 0.5)
		applyProps(terrain, t, a)
	end

	-- Motion blur from camera rotation speed
	local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
	if features.MotionBlur then
		local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(lastLook:Dot(look), -1, 1))
		local turnSpeed = angle / math.max(dt, 1 / 240)
		local target = math.clamp(turnSpeed * MOTION_BLUR_STRENGTH, 0, MOTION_BLUR_MAX)
		motionBlur.Size += (target - motionBlur.Size) * (1 - math.exp(-dt * 14))
		motionBlur.Enabled = motionBlur.Size > 0.3
	end
	lastLook = look

	-- Vignette (+ low-health pulse)
	local vigTarget = features.Vignette and (preset.Vignette * S + wx.gloom * 0.1) or 0
	if danger > 0 then
		vigTarget += danger * 0.45 + math.sin(os.clock() * 7) * 0.08 * danger
	end
	vig += (vigTarget - vig) * a
	setVignette(vig)

	-- Cinematic bars (2.39:1)
	local barFrac = math.max(0, (1 - (vp.X / math.max(vp.Y, 1)) / 2.39) / 2)
	local barTarget = features.Letterbox and barFrac or 0
	barCur += (barTarget - barCur) * math.min(1, a * 2)
	barTop.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, barCur)
	barBottom.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, barCur)

	-- Lens flare
	updateFlare(dt, sunDir, vp)

	-- Snow follows the camera; both snow and rain fade out when you're sheltered or underwater
	local shelter = (1 - indoor) * (1 - uw)
	snowPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(camera.CFrame.Position + Vector3.new(0, 35, 0))
	snowEmitter.Rate = 300 * wx.snow * shelter * qualityScale
	updateRain(dt, wx.rain * shelter * qualityScale, 6 + 10 * wx.storm, vp)

	-- Speed FOV
	if features.SpeedFOV and rootPart and rootPart.Parent then
		local speed = rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
		local target = baseFov + math.clamp((speed - 20) * 0.4, 0, 22)
		camera.FieldOfView += (target - camera.FieldOfView) * fa
		fovTouched = true
	elseif fovTouched then
		camera.FieldOfView += (baseFov - camera.FieldOfView) * a
		if math.abs(camera.FieldOfView - baseFov) < 0.05 then
			camera.FieldOfView = baseFov
			fovTouched = false
		end
	end
end)

--// Handheld camera sway (runs right after the default camera) ---------------------------------------------------
local swaySeed = math.random() * 100
RunService:BindToRenderStep("SP_CameraSway", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
	if not (config.Master and features.CameraSway) then return end
	local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return end

	local t = os.clock() + swaySeed
	local planar = 0
	if rootPart and rootPart.Parent then
		local v = rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		planar = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude
	end
	local move = math.clamp(planar / 16, 0, 1)
	local amp = 0.0015 + move * 0.0035 + wx.storm * 0.004
	local pitch = math.sin(t * 1.1) * amp + math.sin(t * 2.3) * amp * 0.4
	local yaw = math.sin(t * 0.9 + 2) * amp
	local roll = math.sin(t * 0.7 + 4) * amp * 0.8
	local bob = math.sin(t * 9) * 0.045 * move
	cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, bob, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, yaw, roll)
end)

local function makeSlider(text, minV, maxV, value, fmt, onChange)
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")

	local track = Instance.new("Frame")

	track.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 6)
	track.BackgroundColor3 = COL_OFF

	fillBar.BackgroundColor3 = COL_SEL
	fillBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fillBar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
	round(fillBar, 3)
	fillBar.Parent = track

	local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
	knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14)
	knob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5)
	knob.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
	knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
	round(knob, 7)
	knob.Parent = track

	local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
	hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hit.Text = ""
	hit.Position = UDim2.new(0, -6, 0, 20)
	hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, 12, 0, 22)
	hit.Parent = holder

	local dragging = false
	local function setValue(v, silent)
		local current = math.clamp(v, minV, maxV)
		local alpha = (current - minV) / (maxV - minV)
		fillBar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(alpha, 1)
		knob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(alpha, 0.5)
		label.Text = text .. ":  " .. fmt(current)
		if not silent then onChange(current) end
	end
	local function fromInput(x)
		local alpha = math.clamp((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(track.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
		setValue(minV + (maxV - minV) * alpha)
	end
	local function isPointer(input)
		return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	end

	hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if isPointer(input) then
			dragging = true
			scroll.ScrollingEnabled = false
			fromInput(input.Position.X)
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			fromInput(input.Position.X)
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and isPointer(input) then
			dragging = false
			scroll.ScrollingEnabled = true
		end
	end)

	setValue(value, true)
	return {
		set = function(v)
			if not dragging then setValue(v, true) end
		end,
	}
end

local function cycleList(listTable, current, step)
	local idx = table.find(listTable, current) or 1
	return listTable[(idx - 1 + step) % #listTable + 1]

	if processed then return end
	local key = input.KeyCode
	if key == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
		panel.Visible = not panel.Visible
	elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.RightBracket then
		setPreset(cycleList(PRESET_ORDER, currentPreset, 1))
	elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.LeftBracket then

	elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.Period then

	elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.Comma then

	end
end)

local function removeESP(player)
    if espDrawings[player] then
        if espDrawings[player].Box then pcall(function() espDrawings[player].Box:Remove() end) end
        if espDrawings[player].Text then pcall(function() espDrawings[player].Text:Remove() end) end
        espDrawings[player] = nil
    end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(removeESP)

-- Main Render Loop
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    -- ESP Processing
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            if not espDrawings[player] and DrawingValid then
                local successBox, box = pcall(function() return Drawing.new("Square") end)
                local successText, txt = pcall(function() return Drawing.new("Text") end)
                
                if successBox and successText then
                    box.Visible = false
                    box.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120)
                    box.Thickness = 1.5
                    box.Filled = false
                    
                    txt.Visible = false
                    txt.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    txt.Size = 13
                    txt.Center = true
                    txt.Outline = true
                    
                    espDrawings[player] = {Box = box, Text = txt}
                end
            end
            
            local cache = espDrawings[player]
            local char = player.Character
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            
            local show = false
            if cache and Settings.ESPEnabled and char and hrp and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                if not Settings.TeamCheck or player.Team ~= LocalPlayer.Team then
                    local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
                    if onScreen then
                        show = true
                        local topPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                        local botPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                        local height = math.abs(topPos.Y - botPos.Y)
                        local boxSize = Vector2.new(height * 0.5, height)
                        local boxPos = Vector2.new(pos.X - boxSize.X / 2, pos.Y - boxSize.Y / 2)
                        
                        cache.Box.Size = boxSize
                        cache.Box.Position = boxPos
                        cache.Box.Visible = Settings.BoxESP
                        
                        local dist = math.floor((Camera.CFrame.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude)
                        cache.Text.Text = player.Name .. " [" .. dist .. "m]"
                        cache.Text.Position = Vector2.new(pos.X, boxPos.Y - 18)
                        cache.Text.Visible = Settings.NameESP
                    end
                end
            end
            
            if cache and not show then
                if cache.Box then cache.Box.Visible = false end
                if cache.Text then cache.Text.Visible = false end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Aimbot Processing
    if Settings.AimbotEnabled and UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Settings.AimbotKey) then
        local closestTarget = nil
        local shortestDist = Settings.FOV
        local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
                if not Settings.TeamCheck or player.Team ~= LocalPlayer.Team then
                    local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                        local head = player.Character.Head
                        local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
                        if onScreen then
                            local dist = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - mousePos).Magnitude
                            if dist < shortestDist then
                                shortestDist = dist
                                closestTarget = head
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        
        if closestTarget then
            Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, closestTarget.Position)
        end
    end
end)

-- Cleanup on Gui destroy
ScreenGui.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
    if not parent then
        for player, _ in pairs(espDrawings) do
            removeESP(player)
        end
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- SPOZI HUB V2.0
-- SINGLE LOCAL SCRIPT
-- For your own Roblox experience
--========================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- CONFIGURATION
local Config = {
    Speed = 28,
    Jump = 50,
    FlySpeed = 50,
    Theme = Color3.fromRGB(110, 65, 255)
}

local flying = false
local minimized = false
local noclip = false
local currentTab = "Movement"
local savedPosition = nil
local connections = {}

-- CLEANUP OLD GUI
local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("SpoziHub")
if old then old:Destroy() end

--========================================================
-- GUI HELPERS
--========================================================

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "SpoziHub"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = playerGui

local function corner(object, radius)
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
    c.Parent = object
    return c
end

local function stroke(object, color, thickness)
    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    s.Color = color
    s.Thickness = thickness or 1
    s.Parent = object
    return s
end

local function tween(object, properties, duration)
    local t = TweenService:Create(
        object,
        TweenInfo.new(duration or 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint),
        properties
    )
    t:Play()
    return t
end

local function createLabel(parent, text, size, position, color)
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = size
    label.Position = position
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = text
    label.TextColor3 = color or Color3.new(1,1,1)
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.TextScaled = true
    label.Parent = parent
    return label
end

local function notify(title, message)
    local box = Instance.new("Frame")
    box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 75)
    box.Position = UDim2.new(1, 280, 0, 25)
    box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(17,17,27)
    box.Parent = gui
    box.ZIndex = 20

    corner(box, 12)
    stroke(box, Config.Theme, 2)

    createLabel(
        box, title,
        UDim2.new(0.9,0,0.35,0),
        UDim2.fromScale(0.05,0.08),
        Config.Theme
    ).ZIndex = 21

    createLabel(
        box, message,
        UDim2.new(0.9,0,0.3,0),
        UDim2.fromScale(0.05,0.52),
        Color3.new(1,1,1)
    ).ZIndex = 21

    tween(box, {
        Position = UDim2.new(1,-275,0,25)
    },0.5)

    task.delay(3,function()
        if box.Parent then
            tween(box,{
                Position=UDim2.new(1,280,0,25)
            },0.4)
            task.wait(0.5)
            box:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

--========================================================
-- LOADING SCREEN
--========================================================

local loading = Instance.new("Frame")
loading.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
loading.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(5,5,12)
loading.Parent = gui

local loadingCard = Instance.new("Frame")
loadingCard.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
loadingCard.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5)
loadingCard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(330,190)
loadingCard.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(17,17,28)
loadingCard.Parent = loading

corner(loadingCard,18)
stroke(loadingCard,Config.Theme,2)

createLabel(
    loadingCard,
    "⚡ SPOZI HUB",
    UDim2.new(0.9,0,0.25,0),
    UDim2.fromScale(0.05,0.12),
    Config.Theme
)

local loadingStatus = createLabel(
    loadingCard,
    "Initializing...",
    UDim2.new(0.9,0,0.15,0),
    UDim2.fromScale(0.05,0.43),
    Color3.new(1,1,1)
)

local barBack = Instance.new("Frame")
barBack.Size = UDim2.new(0.8,0,0,9)
barBack.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.1,0.72)
barBack.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,55)
barBack.Parent = loadingCard
corner(barBack,10)

local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
bar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0,1)
bar.BackgroundColor3 = Config.Theme
bar.Parent = barBack
corner(bar,10)

local steps = {
    {"Loading interface...",0.2},
    {"Preparing movement...",0.45},
    {"Loading settings...",0.7},
    {"Almost ready...",1}
}

for _,step in ipairs(steps) do
    loadingStatus.Text = step[1]
    tween(bar,{Size=UDim2.fromScale(step[2],1)},0.6)
    task.wait(0.65)
end

--========================================================
-- MAIN WINDOW
--========================================================

local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
main.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5)
main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(360,400)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12,12,20)
main.Visible = false
main.Parent = gui

corner(main,16)
stroke(main,Config.Theme,2)

local header = Instance.new("Frame")
header.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,55)
header.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25,18,45)
header.Parent = main
corner(header,14)

createLabel(
    header,
    "⚡ SPOZI HUB",
    UDim2.new(0.7,0,0.65,0),
    UDim2.fromScale(0.05,0.15),
    Config.Theme
)

local minimizeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
minimizeButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(35,35)
minimizeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1,-45,0,10)
minimizeButton.Text = "—"
minimizeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
minimizeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55,40,85)
minimizeButton.Parent = header
corner(minimizeButton,8)

--========================================================
-- DRAG SYSTEM
--========================================================

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = main.Position
    end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart

        main.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- CONTENT AREA
--========================================================

local content = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
content.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10,110)
content.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-120)
content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
content.BorderSizePixel = 0
content.ScrollBarThickness = 3
content.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
content.Parent = main

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0,10)
layout.Parent = content

layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
    content.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(
        0,0,0,layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 15
    )
end)

local function clearContent()
    for _,item in ipairs(content:GetChildren()) do
        if item:IsA("GuiObject") and item ~= layout then
            item:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

local function button(text, callback)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Size = UDim2.new(1,-5,0,42)
    b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30,25,45)
    b.Text = text
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    b.TextSize = 14
    b.Parent = content
    corner(b,9)
    stroke(b,Config.Theme,1)

    b.Activated:Connect(callback)

    return b
end

local function textBox(placeholder, defaultValue)
    local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
    box.Size = UDim2.new(1,-5,0,42)
    box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25,25,38)
    box.PlaceholderText = placeholder
    box.Text = tostring(defaultValue)
    box.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    box.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    box.TextSize = 14
    box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    box.Parent = content
    corner(box,9)
    stroke(box,Config.Theme,1)
    return box
end

--========================================================
-- CHARACTER HELPERS
--========================================================

local function getCharacter()
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return end

    return character, humanoid
end

--========================================================
-- MOVEMENT TAB
--========================================================

local function movementTab()
    clearContent()

    button("SPEED: "..Config.Speed,function()
        local box = textBox("Enter speed",Config.Speed)

        box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
            if not enter then return end

            local value = tonumber(box.Text)
            if not value then
                notify("ERROR","Enter a valid number")
                return
            end

            Config.Speed = math.clamp(value,0,100)

            local _,humanoid = getCharacter()
            if humanoid then
                humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.Speed
            end

            notify("SPEED UPDATED",tostring(Config.Speed))
        end)
    end)

    button("JUMP POWER: "..Config.Jump,function()
        local box = textBox("Enter jump power",Config.Jump)

        box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
            if not enter then return end

            local value = tonumber(box.Text)
            if not value then return end

            Config.Jump = math.clamp(value,0,150)

            local _,humanoid = getCharacter()
            if humanoid then
                humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
                humanoid.JumpPower = Config.Jump
            end

            notify("JUMP UPDATED",tostring(Config.Jump))
        end)
    end)

    button("FLY: "..(flying and "ON" or "OFF"),function()
        flying = not flying
        notify("FLIGHT",flying and "Enabled" or "Disabled")
        movementTab()
    end)

    button("SAVE POSITION",function()
        local character = player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root then
            savedPosition = root.CFrame
            notify("POSITION SAVED","Location stored")
        end
    end)

    button("RETURN TO SAVED POSITION",function()
        local character = player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if root and savedPosition then
            root.CFrame = savedPosition
            notify("TELEPORT","Returned to saved location")
        else
            notify("ERROR","No saved location")
        end
    end)

    button("RESET CHARACTER",function()
        local _,humanoid = getCharacter()
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.Health = 0
        end
    end)
end

--========================================================
-- VISUALS TAB
--========================================================

local function visualsTab()
    clearContent()

    button("SHOW NPC NAMES",function()
        notify("VISUALS","Use your own game's NPC display system")
    end)

    button("SHOW OBJECT NAMES",function()
        notify("VISUALS","Object visualization selected")
    end)

    button("REMOVE VISUALS",function()
        notify("VISUALS","No external visualizers active")
    end)
end

--========================================================
-- SETTINGS TAB
--========================================================

local function settingsTab()
    clearContent()

    button("PURPLE THEME",function()
        Config.Theme = Color3.fromRGB(110,65,255)
        notify("THEME","Purple selected")
    end)

    button("RED THEME",function()
        Config.Theme = Color3.fromRGB(255,45,65)
        notify("THEME","Red selected")
    end)

    button("RESET SETTINGS",function()
        Config.Speed = 28
        Config.Jump = 50
        flying = false
        notify("SETTINGS","Defaults restored")
    end)

    button("CLOSE HUB",function()
        gui:Destroy()
    end)
end

--========================================================
-- TAB NAVIGATION
--========================================================

local tabs = Instance.new("Frame")
tabs.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10,65)
tabs.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,0,38)
tabs.BackgroundTransparency = 1
tabs.Parent = main

local function createTab(name,x,callback)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Size = UDim2.new(1/3,-5,1,0)
    b.Position = UDim2.new(x,0,0,0)
    b.Text = name
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35,25,55)
    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    b.TextSize = 12
    b.Parent = tabs
    corner(b,7)

    b.Activated:Connect(callback)
end

createTab("MOVEMENT",0,movementTab)
createTab("VISUALS",1/3,visualsTab)
createTab("SETTINGS",2/3,settingsTab)

--========================================================
-- FLY CONTROLLER
--========================================================

local vertical = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not flying then return end

    local character,humanoid = getCharacter()
    if not character then return end

    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end

    local move = humanoid.MoveDirection
    local y = 0

    if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
        y = 1
    elseif UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
        y = -1
    end

    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
        move * Config.FlySpeed + Vector3.new(0,y*Config.FlySpeed,0)
end)

--========================================================
-- RESPAWN SUPPORT
--========================================================

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

    task.wait(0.25)

    humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.Speed
    humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
    humanoid.JumpPower = Config.Jump

    notify("SPOZI HUB","Character reloaded")
end)

--========================================================
-- MINIMIZE
--========================================================

minimizeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    minimized = not minimized

    content.Visible = not minimized
    tabs.Visible = not minimized

    main.Size = minimized
        and UDim2.fromOffset(360,55)
        or UDim2.fromOffset(360,400)
end)

--========================================================
-- START
--========================================================

movementTab()

task.wait(0.5)

tween(loadingCard,{
    Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)
},0.4)

task.wait(0.4)

loading:Destroy()
main.Visible = true

notify("SPOZI HUB","Successfully loaded!")

print("[SPOZI HUB] Version 2.0 loaded")

	-- Theme / Font / Radius use the library defaults (Light, DenkOne 150%, radius 20)

	-----------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Key system (optional). Disabled here; set Enabled = true to gate the
	-- window behind a key prompt. The window opens only after a valid key.
	-- Pick ONE of the validation methods below (checked in this order):
	--   1. Provider = "luarmor"  2. Validate  3. Keys  4. Url
	-----------------------------------------------------------------------
	KeySystem = {
		Enabled = false,
		Title = "Verification",                     -- prompt title
		Note = "Enter your key to continue.",       -- prompt hint text
		GetKeyUrl = "https://example.com/getkey",   -- adds a "Get key" button that copies this link
		Remember = true,                            -- remember a valid key between runs

		-- 1) Luarmor: validates the key with your Luarmor script
		-- Provider = "luarmor",
		-- ScriptId = "your-luarmor-script-id",

		-- 2) Custom function: return true (or false, "message")
		-- Validate = function(key)
		-- 	return key == "my-secret-key", "Wrong key"
		-- end,

		-- 3) Fixed list of accepted keys
		-- Keys = { "KEY-ONE", "KEY-TWO" },

		-- 4) Remote check: %s is replaced with the typed key. The server should
		--    reply with JSON like {"valid": true}, or the text "valid".
		--    Optional Check(body) lets you parse the reply yourself.
		-- Url = "https://example.com/api/check?key=%s",
		-- Check = function(body) return body == "OK" end,

		-- Runs once the key is accepted
		OnPass = function(win)

scripts.code:
-- NEON HUB - COMPLETE SINGLE LOCALSCRIPT
-- Place in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts
-- For your own Roblox Studio experience

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local settings = {
    CartmanESP = false,
    CrankESP = false,
    LockerESP = false,
    Noclip = false,
    SafeHide = false,
    Fullbright = false,
    SpeedHack = false
}

local highlights = {}
local nameTags = {}
local originalCollision = {}
local originalSpawn
local lastHide = 0
local speedConnection

local HIDE_DISTANCE = 20
local TELEPORT_COOLDOWN = 2
local SPEED = 50

-- SAVE ORIGINAL SPAWN
local function saveSpawn(character)
    local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)

    if root and not originalSpawn then
        originalSpawn = root.CFrame
    end
end

if player.Character then
    task.spawn(saveSpawn, player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    task.wait(0.5)

    if not originalSpawn then
        saveSpawn(character)
    end

    table.clear(originalCollision)

    if settings.SpeedHack then
        task.wait(0.5)
        setSpeedHack(true)
    end
end)

-- GUI
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "NeonHub"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(230, 465)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -115, 0.5, -232)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true
frame.Parent = gui

Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 35, 35)
title.Text = "NEON HUB"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 18
title.Parent = frame

Instance.new("UICorner", title).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

-- BUTTON CREATOR
local function makeButton(label, y, setting, callback)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 38)
    button.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, y)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    button.TextSize = 14
    button.Text = label .. ": OFF"
    button.Parent = frame

    Instance.new("UICorner", button).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)

    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        settings[setting] = not settings[setting]

        button.Text = label .. (settings[setting] and ": ON" or ": OFF")

        button.BackgroundColor3 = settings[setting]
            and Color3.fromRGB(130, 40, 40)
            or Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)

        if callback then
            callback(settings[setting])
        end
    end)
end

-- MATCHING HELPER
local function matches(object, words)
    local name = string.lower(object.Name)

    for _, word in ipairs(words) do
        if string.find(name, word, 1, true) then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

-- CARTMAN DETECTION
local function isCartmanCandidate(model)
    if not model:IsA("Model") then
        return false
    end

    local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not humanoid or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
        return false
    end

    if string.find(string.lower(model.Name), "cartman", 1, true) then
        return true
    end

    for _, descendant in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("Script") or descendant:IsA("LocalScript") then
            local scriptName = string.lower(descendant.Name)

            if scriptName == "cartman"
                or string.sub(scriptName, -1) == "n" then
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function findCartmanModel()
    for _, object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if object:IsA("Model") and isCartmanCandidate(object) then
            return object
        end
    end

    return nil
end

-- HIGHLIGHTS
local function addHighlight(object, color)
    if highlights[object] then return end

    if not (object:IsA("Model") or object:IsA("BasePart")) then
        return
    end

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Adornee = object
    highlight.FillColor = color
    highlight.OutlineColor = color
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.55
    highlight.Parent = gui

    highlights[object] = highlight
end

local function removeHighlight(object)
    if highlights[object] then
        highlights[object]:Destroy()
        highlights[object] = nil
    end
end

-- NAME TAGS
local function addNameTag(model, text)
    if nameTags[model] then return end

    local adornee = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
        or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not adornee or not adornee:IsA("BasePart") then
        return
    end

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Name = "NeonHubNameTag"
    billboard.Adornee = adornee
    billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 35)
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.Parent = adornee

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = text
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.TextScaled = true
    label.Parent = billboard

    nameTags[model] = billboard
end

local function removeNameTag(model)
    if nameTags[model] then
        nameTags[model]:Destroy()
        nameTags[model] = nil
    end
end

-- ESP SCANNER
local function scanESP()
    local cartman = findCartmanModel()

    if cartman and settings.CartmanESP then
        addHighlight(cartman, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
        addNameTag(cartman, "FATTIE")
    elseif cartman then
        removeHighlight(cartman)
        removeNameTag(cartman)
    end

    for _, object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if settings.CrankESP
            and matches(object, {"door crank", "doorcrank", "crank"}) then

            addHighlight(object, Color3.fromRGB(170, 0, 255))

        elseif settings.LockerESP and matches(object, {"locker"}) then

            addHighlight(object, Color3.fromRGB(255, 145, 0))
        end
    end

    -- CLEAN UP UNUSED HIGHLIGHTS
    for object in pairs(highlights) do
        local keep = object:IsDescendantOf(workspace)

        if keep then
            local isCartman = cartman and object == cartman

            local isCrank = settings.CrankESP
                and matches(object, {"door crank", "doorcrank", "crank"})

            local isLocker = settings.LockerESP
                and matches(object, {"locker"})

            keep = (settings.CartmanESP and isCartman)
                or isCrank
                or isLocker
        end

        if not keep then
            removeHighlight(object)
        end
    end

    for model in pairs(nameTags) do
        if not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
            or not settings.CartmanESP
            or model ~= cartman then
            removeNameTag(model)
        end
    end
end

-- NOCLIP
local function setNoclip(enabled)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    if enabled then
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                if originalCollision[part] == nil then
                    originalCollision[part] = part.CanCollide
                end

                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    else
        for part, oldValue in pairs(originalCollision) do
            if part.Parent then
                part.CanCollide = oldValue
            end
        end

        table.clear(originalCollision)
    end
end

-- FULLBRIGHT
local originalLighting = {
    Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
    ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
    FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
    GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
    Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
    OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient
}

local function setFullbright(enabled)
    if enabled then
        Lighting.Brightness = 3
        Lighting.ClockTime = 14
        Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    else
        for property, value in pairs(originalLighting) do
            Lighting[property] = value
        end
    end
end

-- SPEED HACK: 50 VELOCITY MODE
function setSpeedHack(enabled)
    if speedConnection then
        speedConnection:Disconnect()
        speedConnection = nil
    end

    if not enabled then return end

    local character = player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not humanoid or not root then return end

    speedConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not root.Parent or not humanoid.Parent then return end

        local direction = humanoid.MoveDirection

        if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
            local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity

            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
                direction.X * SPEED,
                velocity.Y,
                direction.Z * SPEED
            )
        end
    end)
end

-- BUTTONS
makeButton("Cartman ESP", 55, "CartmanESP")
makeButton("Door Crank ESP", 100, "CrankESP")
makeButton("Locker ESP", 145, "LockerESP")
makeButton("Noclip", 190, "Noclip", setNoclip)
makeButton("Safe Hide Cartman", 235, "SafeHide")
makeButton("Fullbright", 280, "Fullbright", setFullbright)
makeButton("Speed Hack (50)", 325, "SpeedHack", setSpeedHack)

-- MAIN LOOP
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local character = player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if settings.Noclip and character then
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                if originalCollision[part] == nil then
                    originalCollision[part] = part.CanCollide
                end

                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end

    if not root or not originalSpawn then
        return
    end

    -- CARTMAN SAFE HIDE: 20 STUDS
    if settings.SafeHide
        and os.clock() - lastHide >= TELEPORT_COOLDOWN then

        local cartman = findCartmanModel()
        local cartmanRoot = cartman
            and cartman:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if cartmanRoot
            and (root.Position - cartmanRoot.Position).Magnitude <= HIDE_DISTANCE then

            lastHide = os.clock()
            character:PivotTo(originalSpawn + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
        end
    end
end)

-- ESP REFRESH
task.spawn(function()
    while gui.Parent do
        scanESP()
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end


local function DisplayAIResponse(message)
    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local senderAdded = false
    
    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if part.type == "text" then
            if not senderAdded then
                AddMessage(currentAI, part.content, false)
                senderAdded = true
            else
                AddMessage("", part.content, false)
            end
        elseif part.type == "code" then
            CreateCodeBlock(part.content, part.language)
        end
    end
end

        animationRunning = false
    end
end

scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
local RootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local currentKey = nil

local function setupCharacter(character)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
    animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://72722244508749"
    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)
    local animTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)

    screenGui:ClearAllChildren()

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 100)
    frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.5, -50)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Parent = screenGui
    frame.Active = true
    frame.Draggable = true

    local playBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    playBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 40)
    playBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
    playBtn.Text = "Play Animation"
    playBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 130, 180)
    playBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    playBtn.Parent = frame

    playBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        animTrack:Play()
    end)

    local keybindBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    keybindBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 40)
    keybindBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50)
    keybindBtn.Text = currentKey and ("Set Keybind (Current: " .. tostring(currentKey) .. ")") or "Set Keybind (Current: none)"
    keybindBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 50, 150)
    keybindBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    keybindBtn.TextScaled = true
    keybindBtn.Parent = frame

    local waitingForKey = false

    keybindBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        keybindBtn.Text = "Press a key..."
        waitingForKey = true
    end)

    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
        if waitingForKey and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
            currentKey = input.KeyCode
            keybindBtn.Text = "Set Keybind (Current: " .. tostring(currentKey) .. ")"
            waitingForKey = false
        elseif currentKey and input.KeyCode == currentKey and not gameProcessed then
            animTrack:Play()
        end
    end)
end

if player.Character then
    setupCharacter(player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    setupCharacter(char)
end)

	local lCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

	local rCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	rCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2)
	rCorner.Parent = rightBtn
	
	local current = default
	local step = (max - min) / 20
	
	leftBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		current = math.max(min, current - step)

		value.Text = tostring(current)
		callback(current)

	rightBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		current = math.min(max, current + step)
		current = math.floor(current * 100 + 0.5) / 100

	end)

local function notify(text, duration)
	local notif = Instance.new("Frame")
	notif.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	notif.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 34, 36)
	notif.BorderSizePixel = 0
	notif.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	notif.ClipsDescendants = true
	notif.Parent = notifications
	
	local nCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	nCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
	nCorner.Parent = notif
	
	local nStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	nStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(85, 90, 95)
	nStroke.Thickness = 1
	nStroke.Transparency = 1
	nStroke.Parent = notif
	
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 210)
	label.TextSize = 11
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextTransparency = 1
	label.Parent = notif
	
	local textBounds = label.TextBounds.Y + 12
	
	TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, textBounds),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0
	}):Play()
	
	TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
	
	task.delay(duration or 3, function()
		TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1
		}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.25)
		notif:Destroy()
	end)
end

local processed = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local originalSounds = {}

local function optimizeGame()
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0
	
	local function process(obj)
		if processed[obj] then return end
		processed[obj] = true
		
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			obj.CastShadow = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
			originalSounds[obj] = obj.SoundId
			if getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then
				obj.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
			end
		elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Texture = getgenv().StretchConfig.DotTexture
			obj.Rate = 5
			obj.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1)

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

-- Função para gerar uma cor aleatória com valores mais altos
local function randomColor()
    return Color3.new(math.random(0, 255)/255, math.random(0, 255)/255, math.random(0, 255)/255)
end

-- Função para aplicar uma cor suavemente
local function lerpColor(startColor, endColor, alpha)
    return startColor:Lerp(endColor, alpha)
end

-- Tempo de transição (em segundos)
local transitionTime = 0.5

-- Remover camisa e calça do jogador
character.Shirt:Destroy()
character.Pants:Destroy()

-- Loop infinito para alterar as cores do corpo
while true do
    local startTime = tick()
    local endTime = startTime + transitionTime
    
    local startColor = randomColor()
    local endColor = randomColor()
    
    while tick() < endTime do
        local elapsedTime = tick() - startTime
        local alpha = elapsedTime / transitionTime
        
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.Color = lerpColor(startColor, endColor, alpha)
                part.Transparency = 0.25
                part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField -- Aqui está a linha que adiciona o material ForceField
            end
        end
        
        wait()
    end
end
   end

Section3:Button({
   Text = "Aim",
   Callback = function()
-- Credit Dollynho --

local fov = 36
local maxDistance = 350
local maxTransparency = 0.1
local teamCheck = false
local wallCheck = true
local aimPart = "Head"  -- "Torso"

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Cam = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera

local FOVring = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVring.Visible = true
FOVring.Thickness = 2
FOVring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 0, 128)
FOVring.Filled = false
FOVring.Radius = fov
FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2

local function updateDrawings()
    FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
end

local function lookAt(target)
    local lookVector = (target - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local newCFrame = CFrame.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, Cam.CFrame.Position + lookVector)
    Cam.CFrame = newCFrame
end

local function calculateTransparency(distance)
    return (1 - (distance / fov)) * maxTransparency
end

local function isPlayerAlive(player)
    local character = player.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, trg_part)
    if not wallCheck then
        return true
    end

    local localPlayerCharacter = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if not localPlayerCharacter then
        return false
    end

    local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(trg_part)
    if not part then
        return false
    end

    local ray = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position)
    local hit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, {localPlayerCharacter})

    if hit and hit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then
        return true
    end

    -- Fallback to a nearby position if the direct ray doesn't hit
    local direction = (part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local nearRay = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position + direction * 2, direction * maxDistance)
    local nearHit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(nearRay, {localPlayerCharacter})

    return nearHit and nearHit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)
end

local function getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    local nearest = nil
    local last = math.huge
    local playerMousePos = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
    local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= localPlayer and (not teamCheck or player.Team ~= localPlayer.Team) and isPlayerAlive(player) then
            local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart)
            if humanoid and part then
                local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - playerMousePos).Magnitude

                if distance < last and isVisible and distance < fov and distance < maxDistance and isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, aimPart) then
                    last = distance
                    nearest = player
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nearest
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    updateDrawings()
    local closest = getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    if closest and closest.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart) then
        lookAt(closest.Character[aimPart].Position)
    end
    
    if closest then
        local part = closest.Character[aimPart]
        local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - (Cam.ViewportSize / 2)).Magnitude
        FOVring.Transparency = calculateTransparency(distance)
    else
        FOVring.Transparency = maxTransparency
    end
end)
        end
})

local function formatNumber(n)
    local formatted = tostring(n)
    local k
    while true do
        formatted, k = string.gsub(formatted, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", '%1,%2')
        if k == 0 then break end
    end
    return formatted
end

local function moveToTarget()
    if humanoidRootPart then
        humanoidRootPart.CFrame = targetPosition

local safes = {}

    for _, child in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Model") then
            if child.Name == "CashRegister" then
                table.insert(cashRegisters, child)
            elseif child.Name == "Safe" then
                table.insert(safes, child)
            end
        end
    end
end

updateCaches()

Workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
    if child:IsA("Model") then
        if child.Name == "CashRegister" then
            table.insert(cashRegisters, child)
        elseif child.Name == "Safe" then
            table.insert(safes, child)
        end
    end
end)

Workspace.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
    if child:IsA("Model") then
        if child.Name == "CashRegister" then
            for i = #cashRegisters, 1, -1 do
                if cashRegisters[i] == child then
                    table.remove(cashRegisters, i)
                end
            end
        elseif child.Name == "Safe" then
            for i = #safes, 1, -1 do
                if safes[i] == child then
                    table.remove(safes, i)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

local function checkCashRegister()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #cashRegisters do
        local item = cashRegisters[i]
        local openPart = item:FindFirstChild("Open")
        if openPart then
            humanoidRootPart.CFrame = openPart.CFrame
            robEvent:FireServer("Register", {
                Part = item:FindFirstChild("Union"),
                OpenPart = openPart,
                ActiveValue = item:FindFirstChild("Active"),
                Active = true
            })
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function checkSafe()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #safes do
        local item = safes[i]
        if item:FindFirstChild("Amount") and item.Amount.Value > 0 then
            local safePart = item:FindFirstChild("Safe")
            if safePart then
                humanoidRootPart.CFrame = safePart.CFrame
                local openFlag = item:FindFirstChild("Open")
                if openFlag and openFlag.Value then
                    robEvent:FireServer("Safe", item)
                else
                    local openSafe = item:FindFirstChild("OpenSafe")
                    if openSafe then
                        openSafe:FireServer("Completed")
                    end
                    robEvent:FireServer("Safe", item)
                end
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not checkCashRegister() then
        checkSafe()
    end
end)

local function Descendants(tbl)
    local descendants = {}
    
    local function process_table(subtbl, prefix)
        for k, v in pairs(subtbl) do
            local index = prefix and (prefix .. "." .. tostring(k)) or tostring(k)
            descendants[index] = v
            if type(v) == 'table' then
                process_table(v, index)
            else
                descendants[index] = v
            end
        end
    end

    if type(tbl) ~= 'table' then
        descendants[tostring(1)] = tbl
    else
        process_table(tbl, nil)
    end
    
    return descendants
end

local function rawlength(tbl)
 local a = 0
 for i, v in pairs(tbl) do
  a = a + 1
 end
 return a
end

local function ToPairsLoop(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns2) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var1, var2, tbl)
            return p.format:format(var1, var2, tbl)
        end)
    end
    return code
end

local function SafeOverride(a, b, c) --[[ Index, Data, Should override ]]
    if getgenv()[a] and not c then return 1 end
    getgenv()[a] = b

    return 2
end

local function toluau(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var, value)
            return p.format:format(var, var, value)
        end)
    end
    code = ToPairsLoop(code)
    return code
end

local Queue = {}
Queue.__index = Queue
function Queue.new()
    local self = setmetatable({}, Queue)
    self.elements = {}
    return self
end

function Queue:Queue(element)
    table.insert(self.elements, element)
end

function Queue:Update()
    if #self.elements == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    return table.remove(self.elements, 1)
end

function Queue:IsEmpty()
    return #self.elements == 0
end
function Queue:Current()
    return self.elements
end

funcs.base64.encode = function(data)
    local letters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    return ((data:gsub('.', function(x) 
        local r,b='',x:byte()
        for i=8,1,-1 do r=r..(b%2^i-b%2^(i-1)>0 and '1' or '0') end
        return r;
    end)..'0000'):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if (#x < 6) then return '' end
        local c=0
        for i=1,6 do c=c+(x:sub(i,i)=='1' and 2^(6-i) or 0) end
        return letters:sub(c+1,c+1)
    end)..({ '', '==', '=' })[#data%3+1])
end
funcs.base64.decode = function(data)
    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    data = string.gsub(data, '[^'..b..'=]', '')
    return (data:gsub('.', function(x)
        if x == '=' then return '' end
        local r, f = '', (b:find(x) - 1)
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do
            r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0')
        end
        return r;
    end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 8 do
            c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2^(8 - i) or 0)
        end
        return string.char(c)
    end))
end

 local key = ''
 local a = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
 for i = 1, optionalSize or 32 do local n = math.random(1, #a) key = key .. a:sub(n, n) end

end

funcs.crypt.encrypt = function(a, b)
 local result = {}
 a = tostring(a) b = tostring(b)
 for i = 1, #a do
    local byte = string.byte(a, i)
    local keyByte = string.byte(b, (i - 1) % #b + 1)
    table.insert(result, string.char(bit32.bxor(byte, keyByte)))
 end
 return table.concat(result)
end

funcs.newcclosure = function(f)
 local a = coroutine.wrap(function(...)
  local b = {coroutine.yield()}
  while true do
   b = {coroutine.yield(f(table.unpack(b)))}
  end
 end)
 a()
 return a
end -- Credits to myworld AND EMPER for this

funcs.isexecutorclosure = function(fnc)
    local found = false
    for i, v in pairs(getgenv()) do
     if v == fnc then return true end
    end
    for i = 1, math.huge do
        local s, env = pcall(getfenv, i)
        if not s or found then break end
        if type(env) == "table" then
            for _, v in pairs(env) do
                if v == fnc then
                    found = true
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if found then break end
    end

    return found
end

funcs.writefile = function(path, content)
 local Path = path:split('/')
 local CurrentPath = {}
 for i = 1, #Path do
  local a = Path[i]
  CurrentPath[i] = a
  if not files[a] and i ~= #Path then
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')] = {}
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/') .. '/'] = files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')]
  elseif i == #Path then
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')] = tostring(content)
  end
 end
end

funcs.loadfile = function(path)
 local content = funcs.readfile(path)
 if not content then error('File \'' .. tostring(path) .. '\' does not exist.') return '' end
 local s, func = pcall(function()
  return loadstring(content)
 end)
 return func, not s and func or nil
end

funcs.listfiles = function(path)
    if not path or path == '' then
     local Files = {}
     for i, v in pairs(files) do
      if #i:split('/') == 1 then table.insert(Files, i) end
     end
     return Files
    end
    if type(files[path]) ~= 'table' then return error(path .. ' is not a folder.') end
    local Files = {}
    for i, v in pairs(files) do
      if startswith(i, path .. '/') and not endswith(i, '/') and i ~= path and #i:split('/') == (#path:split('/') + 1) then table.insert(Files, i) end
    end
    return Files
end
